articleTitle: Unit Cells of Flexible Printed Graphene Reflectarray Antenna for Satellite and Microwave Communications
publicationTitle: 2021 XV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems Of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Flexible reflectarray are widely used as deployable antennas in the design of small satellites (weight about 320 kg) to reduce the weight and size characteristics. Modern flexible reflectarray antenna use metals as the conductive material. Graphene has unique properties that are suitable for flexible antenna systems - mechanical stability, low specific gravity and cost. This paper is the first to consider the possibility of using graphene as a conductive material in the design of unit cell elements of a reflectarray antenna in the GHz range: a patch element, a patch element with a ring, and a patch element with a delay line. The minimum values of the incident wave amplitude and the phase variation range for each element were -4.08 dB and 327.6 degrees, -19.63 dB and 684.73 degrees, -6.24 dB and 526 degrees, respectively. The comparison of the obtained characteristics of unit cell elements with similar silver elements is carried out. Comparison of the characteristics with the literature analogs showed that the printed graphene unit cell elements of the reflectarray antenna have satisfactory characteristics.

articleTitle: Experimental Evaluation of UWB Local Navigation System Performance Used for Pedestrian and Vehicle Positioning in Outdoor Urban Environments
publicationTitle: 2021 XV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems Of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Currently provision of reliable PNT information in GNSS-challenged conditions is remaining a difficult task because of several factors which have a significant impact on signal propagation and its steady and proper reception such as multipath, attenuation or blockage of the GNSS LOS signal, interference by wide class of signals in GNSS frequency band. To improve the reliability of PNT information in outdoor urban environments, it is proposed to use UWB LNS due to low multipath effect on its signals. For this reason, the main purpose of this work is evaluation of the features of constructing LNS based on UWB signals in urban conditions, as well as comparison of error of navigation solution and plane coordinates based on GNSS and UWB signals. Two experiments described in this paper were conducted. The first experiment was aimed at determining the maximum operating range of UWB LNS, the second experiment was focused on evaluation of UWB LNS performance in outdoor urban environments. In conclusion discussion of obtained results is presented.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Impact of Autonomous Hybrid Power Plants on the Railways Capacity
publicationTitle: 2021 XV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems Of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: In this paper the problem of reducing the capacity of the railway due to a decrease in voltage levels on the sections remote from the power substations is considered. As one of the options for solving this task, the usage of autonomous hybrid electric power plant as an additional power source for the problem sections of the railway is proposed. The description of AHPP structure, principles of their interaction and the simulation model developed by using Matlab Simulink are given in the paper. Also the analysis of the influence of AHPP modes on the voltage level in the contact network of the railway section has been performed for three cases: power supply from two substations without using AHPP; with installation of AHPP at one of the traction substations; with installation of AHPP in the section between substations in the middle of the track. Based on the results of the analysis, the assessment of the feasibility of AHPP using in the electrification systems of railways was performed.

articleTitle: Energy Efficiency Improvement of Industrial Enterprise Based on Machine Learning Electricity Tariff Forecasting
publicationTitle: 2021 XV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems Of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: One of the most important tasks for a large industrial enterprise is to reduce the production cost. The electricity cost for each industrial enterprise is formed by many factors, some of which can be influenced to reduce final costs. An overview of existing methods of load regulation is presented, as well as an assessment of their feasibility and efficiency in terms of reducing the cost of electricity and power. Mid-term forecasting electricity tariff rate to change the load schedule can reduce the company's electricity costs. The possibility of building a machine learning model predicting the retail market hourly electricity tariff rate has been studied. Modeling was performed on the publicly available data of electricity prices in the Novosibirsk region (Russia) for 2018–2020. It was found out that Extreme Gradient Boosting over regression decision trees can predict the hourly electricity tariff rate for a month ahead with a mean absolute percentage error of 4 %.

articleTitle: Approach to Integration of a Synthesis Tool and PDK for Commercial EDA
publicationTitle: 2021 XV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems Of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Models from PDKs are needed to consider the MMIC manufacturing process in the schematic synthesis. PDKs are developed for specific commercial EDA. The information about PDK's models is often proprietary, which leads to some difficulties during the synthesis process. In this paper the approaches to integrate a synthesis tool and a PDK are considered. PDK twin approach is selected as the most efficient. The software for a PDK twin generation is presented. The developed software supported compatibility between the synthesis solution based on PDK twin elements and proprietary PDK. The high model accuracy, versatility for any kind of MMIC elements and PDK supported by the EDA, timesaving simulation due to behavioral model are the main advantages of the proposed approach. Approaches comparison was carried out based on the distributed amplifier synthesis software. Estimates show that the PDK twin using could reduce the time to get model characteristics during the synthesis by 5 orders.

articleTitle: Analysis of Artificial Intelligence Methods for Detecting Drones Based on Radio Frequency Activity
publicationTitle: 2021 XV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems Of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The main illegal tasks of unmanned aerial vehicles are conducting reconnaissance, delivering prohibited goods, as well as striking transport and energy infrastructure facilities. The insignificant linear dimensions of drones reduce the effectiveness of their detection and their countering. Therefore, it is very important to know how to identify these devices, as well as be able to use them. Different data sets are needed to conduct such experiments. They are used for analysis to determine the most important elements. Therefore, data sets are a very valuable resource. This article describes the development of a classifier that determines the maximum information about unmanned aerial vehicles based on radio frequency data. The classifier is a convolutional neural network that can recognize the presence of a drone and the type of drone. The results showed that the developed product works better than existing analogues. Such indicators as accuracy, precision, recall and f1 metrics are 2% higher than those available for existing solutions.

articleTitle: SDR Based Evaluation of the Initial Cell Search In 5G NR OpenAirInterface Implementation
publicationTitle: 2021 XV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems Of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: For the 5G network connection user equipment (UE) must perform the initial cell search and obtain information of signal synchronization. The main goal of initial cell search is to detect the presence of the signal from the cell transmitting antennas in the frequency range and to perform the symbol and frame synchronization. After initial synchronization the UE can obtain and decode minimal system information. For this purpose, the SSB is used. The estimation of the synchronization signals detection probability is shown in that paper and verified by SDR based 5G realization. As the system framework the OpenAir Interface software is used in combination with USRP hardware allowing to implement 5G NR network in lab enviorenment. The real SSB samples from the OpenAirInterface implementation are used in simulation of the initial cell search.

articleTitle: The Novel Printed Log-Periodic Antenna with Dipole-Like Radiators Excited by Using the Modified in-Phase Power Splitter
publicationTitle: 2021 XV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems Of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The article deals with the novel printed log-periodic antenna. It contains a printed assembly of the so-called center-end-fed dipole-like stretched radiators. The modified printed-circuit-board two-layer topology of the power splitter is proposed in order to excite the modified log-periodic dipole-like antenna composed of the center-end-fed dipole-like radiator. This splitter is based on the slot-line-microstrip transitions. The systematic analysis of the splitter as well as the log-periodic array itself is presented. All the key geometrical dimensions are derived through the nonlinear parametric optimization using the 3D full-wave solver like “CST Studio Suite”. Prior to implementation of the whole printed log-periodic antenna, the main fragments of that were manufactured and successfully tested. The experimental results agree well with the simulation-derived ones. The incorporation of proposed splitter and radiator into design procedures leads to increase the degree of freedom in microwave region that paves a way for next generation of the ultra-wideband microwave antennas.

articleTitle: Image Processing of Insulator and Vibration Damper by YOLO Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 XV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems Of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Image processing is widely used in many fields, including electronics, computer science, energy, construction, medicine, and self-driving cars. Deep learning based object detection methods have also evolved to detect in real-time. Depending on the nature of the object or image to be processed, the performance of image processing methods will vary from application to application. Therefore, researchers test different types of algorithms in each case and compare performance results. The study aims to detect and report selected objects, such as insulators and vibration dampers. This video was recorded by using an UAV in a power transmission line. The research aims to identify the insulator from the input data processed by image processing, create an image database, and then report the visible physical damages. This study summarizes the results of a study in which video insulators and vibration dampers were detected using the DL youonly look once algorithm.

articleTitle: Controllable Rectifiers with Input Power Factor Correction
publicationTitle: 2021 XV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems Of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Innovative single-phase and three-phase power factor correctors based on the Cuk circuit with a quasi-sinusoidal input current in phase with a voltage are analyzed. This kind of rectifiers with forced formation of the input current has such properties as the output voltage control in the full range, the bidirectional active power flow if it is needed. Also galvanic isolated and transformerless circuitry solutions of the rectifier cell are presented. The load and control characteristics of the single-phase power-factor-corrected rectifier cell based on modified Cuk circuit with symmetrized output circuit are obtained. The offered rectifier cells can be connected by input in various ways, in particular, the wye connection is used in three-phase rectifiers, and the series connection is applied in high-voltage single-phase rectifiers. All these rectifiers are necessary for new branches of electrical engineering, including chargers for electric car batteries, sources of controlled DC voltage for an inverter frequency electric drive with the output AC voltage amplitude control, energy storage systems and a number of electrical technologies. The modular composition principle makes it possible to enhance their applications and to form a broad range of power-factor-corrected DC sources by output voltage and power rating.

articleTitle: GLONASS Satellite Pseudorange Errors Mitigation Using Gradient Boosting Machine
publicationTitle: 2021 XV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems Of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: For the past two decades, navigation satellite systems have become an essential part of everyday life, their help cannot be overestimated, and many applications require high positioning precision and accuracy. However, these demands still cannot be completely satisfied and other sources of pseudorange errors should also be taken into consideration. This study proposed a gradient boosting machine method of mitigating residual pseudorange error to improve positioning results. The paper also presents the way the residual can be computed, given the known user coordinates. To prove the model validity, the experiment was conducted, that comprised of several stages: data collection, residual computation, model training, residual prediction and positioning calculation. For the validation dataset (unseen data), the positioning error decreased by almost 50 percent, the standard deviation for the ellipsoidal coordinates error reduced from 1.38 meters to 0.68 meters, comparing with the standard navigation equation solution. The experiment shows that gradient boosting machine can greatly improve accuracy and precision.

articleTitle: Wideband High-Gain Dual-Polarized Antenna for 5G Communications
publicationTitle: 2021 XV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems Of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The most relevant and required wireless systems in the world are the mobile communication of fourth-generation technologies. However, the requirements for communication systems are rather quickly demanding, especially for the development of more advanced and efficient technologies. It has led to the need to develop the fifth-generation communication systems. One of the most popular elements for use in the 5G networks is the n78 sub-band with frequencies from 3300 to 3800 MHz. In Russia, the frequency band from 3400 to 3800 MHz (L TE bands 42 and 43) is intended for the deployment of 5G networks. Implementation of new frequency ranges requires the development of new antennas. This paper describes the wideband four-element dual-polarized antenna array with low-cost and low-profile for the high-gain applications operating at frequencies 3.4-3.8 GHz. The paper provides the antenna design description and the simulation and measurement results. The obtained results show that the designed antenna provides the good radiation performance.

articleTitle: Synthesis of a Dual-Band Circular Polarization Antenna for Global Navigation Satellite System GLONASS
publicationTitle: 2021 XV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems Of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: A topology of a printed dual-band circular polarization antenna for receiving GLONASS L1 and L2 signals is proposed. The antenna consists of two radiating webs and a signal adder made on the same substrate in one technological cycle, the combination of signals is provided by a Wilkinson adder. The emitters are made in the form of printed resonant antennas with circular polarization. Circular polarization is provided by a phase-shifting loop. The electric field intensity vector rotation direction is determined by the side of the square to which the phase-shifting loop is connected. The article presents the geometric dimensions of the antenna for the FR4 material, if it is necessary to reduce antenna size, the material can be replaced with a more expensive one with a higher relative permittivity. The results of measuring the reflection coefficient modulus of the prototype antenna are presented. Mathematical modeling of the developed antenna is carried out and comparative results of modeling and experimental sample are presented.

articleTitle: Performance Evaluation of the MU-MIMO Beamforming U sing Open Source Channel Model
publicationTitle: 2021 XV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems Of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: This paper presents the numerical evaluation of the multiuser MIMO beamforming algorithms ZF and DFT codebook in practical deployment scenarios based on QUAD RIGA channel model reflecting the real propagation conditions. The generated channels are used to calculate SINR and the spectral efficiency of each user applying the conventional ZF and DFT codebok beamforming. The DFT codebook precoding is based on the channel quantisation and as channel state information uses the computed index and norm feedback. The obtained performance of MU-MIMO ZF and DFT codebok based beamforming in spatially correlated channel are compared based on the empirical cumulative density function of the sum rate of multiple users. Numerical results show that the less complex DFT precoding is more robust in interference suppression than ZF in ill-conditioning channel and outperforms the ZF precoder in the spectral efficiency. Obtained results can be used by the user grouping algorithm evaluation in the system level simulations.

articleTitle: Dielectric Wavelength-Scaled Metalenses Based on an Anomalous Apodization Effect for Photoconductive Optical-to-Terahertz Switches
publicationTitle: 2021 XV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems Of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: A new strategy to improve the enhancement of an optical wave confinement in photoconductive antenna by implementation of a single or array of dielectric wavelength-scaled structures of different shape featuring symmetrical and broken symmetry into PCA's gap is offered. The results of the simulation and optimization of these novel-designed PCAs are discussed. The spectral and power characteristics, and the efficiency of optical-to-terahertz switches are the key parameters. To increase the efficiency of the OT conversion, the use of mesoscale dielectric particle placed onto the gap between the electrodes of optical-to-terahertz switches was offered. It has been shown, that it is possible to increase the field intensity localization of light (about 9.6 times) and to achieve the minimal beam waist of about 0.32 <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\lambda_{0}$</tex> in photoconductor, which is below the Abbe diffraction limit. The proposed design of a metalens based on a single or array of dielectric wavelength-scaled particles (dielectric grating or colloidal particles) with anomalous apodization effect can become a promising way for increasing the efficiency of an optical-to-terahertz switches and increase the photocurrent about 1.4 - 1.5 times.

articleTitle: Resolution Analysis of Airborne Electromagnetic Survey Using Helicopter Platform and UAV
publicationTitle: 2021 XV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems Of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The paper considers the possibilities of time-domain airborne electromagnetic exploration technologies using both standard helicopter platforms and unmanned aerial vehicles with a source in the form of a long grounded electrical line when prospecting ore deposits. The analysis is carried out using finite element modeling programs and the results of field experiments, which made it possible to obtain the noise level. A geoelectric model obtained as a result of processing data from airborne electromagnetic prospecting in the Ural region is considered. The influence of the tilt of the target object and its position relative to the transmitter line are analyzed. The simulation takes into account topography, the curved surface of the target, and heterogeneities in the overburden layers. Numerical modeling makes it possible to clarify the noise level of the measuring equipment and establish the requirements for the minimum measurement accuracy for solving electromagnetic exploration problems of the class under consideration. Computational experiments have shown that when searching for ore objects lying at depths of up to 200 m, both technologies make it possible to recover the location and shape of the target objects in plan and in depth.

articleTitle: Genetic Algorithm for Antenna Array Thinning with Minimization of Side Lobe Level
publicationTitle: 2021 XV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems Of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: In this paper, an algorithm for thinning a linear antenna array is presented. The algorithm is aimed to minimize maximum side lobe level while maintaining minimal loss of initial half-power beamwidth. As a result, the algorithm determines a combination of active and inactive array elements for a required thinning coefficient. An effect of mutation and population size is discussed. The proximity of obtained solution to an optimal one is evaluated for multiple array sizes. The suggested algorithm allows to achieve maximum side lobe level of thinned array, it is lower than one of global optimum solution up to -1.5 dB on average. The classification of antenna array thinning methods is introduced. Comparison results for different thinning methods are provided. Two methods have an obvious advantage above the others. An emphasis is made on the research of thinned antenna array characteristics with various amplitude tapers in comparison with the characteristics of full array.

articleTitle: Characteristics Research of the Semiconductor Frequency Converter in Matlab Simulink
publicationTitle: 2021 XV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems Of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Due to competition in the global market, Russian mining enterprises are striving to improve their technical equipment and energy efficiency. Improvement of electric drive systems of mechanisms involved in mining can lead to significant results in solving this problem. In this regard, much attention is paid to the development of more advanced devices used in the electric drive. Currently, various devices for starting, operating and regulating the speed of three-phase squirrel cage induction motors are being developed. To check the performance of the developed devices, a variety of research methods are used, one of which is computer simulation. The article discusses an original adjustable transistor gearbox for a three-phase squirrel cage induction motor powered by a DC power. The urgency of using a semiconductor converter in drives of mechanisms of mining enterprises has been substantiated. To study the operation of the motor in the environment in the Matlab Simulink environment, a simulation model of the developed drive was created. To analyze the characteristics of an induction motor when working with a semiconductor converter, they were compared with the natural mechanical characteristic.

articleTitle: Locating an Object inside a Room under Line-of-Sight Conditions between Transmitter and Receiver
publicationTitle: 2021 XV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems Of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Using the trilateration mechanism for local positioning requires a careful study of the mobile object's coordinates calculation methods, based on the measurement of various physical parameters (signal strength level at the receiver, signal propagation delay, reception angle, etc.). This article will be about choosing the radio propagation model in a case where the transmitter and receiver antennas are located in line of sight of each other inside the room. Increasing the accuracy of determining the subscriber device's coordinates up to 3–5 meters, which is the main goal of this work, is achieved through analytical modeling and field tests of the positioning system in the sampling points of the room. Approximation of the difference between the measured and calculated signal attenuation values by the linear regression allows finding the coefficients of additional losses in the premises manifesting because of multiple signal's reflections from obstacles and other factors. The results of processing experimental data obtained by measuring the signal strength at the sampling points are derived. These data are compared with the results of calculations and used as the basis for determining the target object's location.

articleTitle: Improvement of Flexibility in the Integrated Energy Systems
publicationTitle: 2021 XV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems Of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: This paper presents possibilities to improve flexibility for integrated energy systems using optimization techniques in a capacity market. Long-term planning of the energy system is considered. Meeting the rapidly growing demand for electricity requires a complete integrated power system solution that must support consumers, stakeholders, and regional operations. The rapid change in the global economy is creating an energy transition towards the strategic future of power systems and energy markets - a new era of flexible grids, or the era of energy flexibility. The proposed capacity market model improves the competitiveness of the energy market system in accordance with the assessment and flexibility of electricity security. It also presents recommendations for evaluating the dimensions of the integrated energy system. All participants in the energy market can accept it as a useful tool to support decision-making and increase the sustainability of the energy system. The smart grids provide the reliability of power supply in an increasingly complex operating environment, achieved through observability, digitalization, and an increase in the number of measurements. Power supply and grid companies remain the main drivers of change.

articleTitle: A Comparison of the Mobility Models Defining MOSFET Threshold Voltage for Low Temperatures
publicationTitle: 2021 XV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems Of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Accurate Technology Computer-Aided Design (TCAD) modeling of silicon integrated circuits (ICs) and semiconductor devices for cryogenic temperatures requires well-calibrated models of electrical parameters. One of these most important parameters is the mobility of charge carriers. In this paper, the mobility models used in TCAD Sentaurus and TCAD Silvaco were analyzed. Using various models, the temperature dependences of the threshold voltage were calculated for an n-channel metal-oxide-semiconductor field-effect transistor (M OSFE T) with a channel length of 1 μm, The contribution of various mobility models to this relationship has been evaluated. The work considered three models of bulk mobility, two models of mobility in an inverse layer, three models of carrier-carrier scattering and one model of mobility in strong electric fields. Comparison with experimental data showed that the main models are the mobility in the inverse layer and bulk mobility. Carrier-to-carrier scattering models do not affect the threshold voltage value. The contribution of the mobility model in strong electric fields is small. As a result, the models that give the most accurate value of the threshold voltage were identified.

articleTitle: Modeling of Scattering Spectra of DNA Molecules
publicationTitle: 2021 XV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems Of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The article discusses the methods of visualization of double-helical right-twisted DNA molecules using ultrashort laser pulses. A molecule is considered as a multielectron atom, on which an electromagnetic field pulse falls in the form of a plane wave. The duration of such a pulse will be considered to be much shorter than the characteristic atomic time, which allows the radiation process to be considered within the framework of the theory of sudden perturbations. The data obtained were compared with X-ray diffraction images. Methods of mathematical physics have been used to describe the interaction of a laser with a substance. In this work, all calculations were carried out in the specialized program Wolfram Mathematics 12.0. Laser parameters: the pulse falls on the system at an angle of 30, n is the angle between the spiral axis and the scattering direction, 0 is the angle between the x axis and the projection on the plane perpendicular to the spiral axis (spherical coordinates are shown on the contour graph as projections), a is the angle of opening of the spiral turn, L is the offset distance between the vertices of the spiral. In addition, the article uses data from X-ray diffraction analysis. Images of DNA molecules are used to compare the theoretical data obtained with the real picture of the molecule. The main focus of this work is on two main types of DNA molecules: DNA type A and DNA type B. The graphical method shows the decoding of the obtained contour graphs by analogy with classical X-ray images.

articleTitle: Hardware and Software Complex for Monitoring Soil and Climatic Parameters
publicationTitle: 2021 XV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems Of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The article discusses agriculture digitalization problem in Russia. Agribusiness development dynamics in Russia and Western Europe countries, USA and Canada are compared. Russian regions positive experience in digitalization tools implementation is presented. The article proposes one of the possible tools for agriculture digitalization in Russia - hardware and software complex for monitoring soil and climatic parameters. Such system expediency, its benefits for science and agriculture are given. Main principles, technologies and algorithms used in system development are described, as well as main development problems and ways to solve them. The article describes in detail hardware and software complex structure and its elements - probe, base station and web interface. The system, each element structure, its composition and purpose, block diagram and operation algorithms description are also described in detail. The article also presents and describes software and hardware complex elements constituent part - sensors, transmitters, a microcontroller, etc. A separate block in article is software and hardware complex testing stage. This block describes testing methodology and its implementation main stages. A temperature sensors comparison inside device was carried out and climatic parameters comparison obtained by software and hardware complex and using RP5 weather forecast service.

articleTitle: Polychromatic Diagnostics of Axisymmetric Reacting Jets and Flames Using the Hilbert Optics Methods
publicationTitle: 2021 XV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems Of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The problem of non-disturbing diagnostics of the phase and temperature fields of the reacting jets and flames is solved in the work. On the example of an axisymmetric hydrogen-diffusion flame, a method was developed, based on Hilbert polychromatic visualization of phase optical density fields, and measuring the temperature profile in selected areas of the medium under study. The diagnostic complex is implemented on the basis of the IAB-451 device. The visualized diffusion flame in the axial symmetry approximation is analyzed using the Abel transform. The reconstruction of the temperature field is carried out considering the diversity of the partial optical properties of the gas mixture in a model consistent with the Gladstone-Dale dispersion formula. The influence of disturbances in the air surrounding the flame on its axial symmetry is discussed. The criterion for the reliability of the research results is a comparison of the hilbertograms obtained in the experiment and the reconstructed hilbertograms.

articleTitle: Comparison of Iterative and Direct Solvers for Finite Element Linear Systems in 3D Induction Logging
publicationTitle: 2021 XV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems Of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Numerical modeling of three-dimensional time-harmonic electro magnetics in the problems of high-frequency induction logging by vector finite element method is considered. Electromagnetic field in the frequency range from 0.875 to 14 MHz is excited by an ungrounded loop of the VIKIZ induction logging tool placed in a horizontally layered medium with three-dimensional inhomogeneities. The curl-curl vector partial differential equation with displacement currents taken into account is used. Edge-based vector basis functions on parallelepipedal elements are used. The obtained finite element systems contain from 47804 to 612122 complex-valued degrees of freedom. Both direct (PARDISO) and iterative complex-valued solvers (COCG, COCR, BICGCR) are used to solve the corresponding systems of linear algebraic equations. The advantage of iterative methods over direct methods is shown for the obtained finite element matrices at the frequency range from 1.75 to 14 MHz. The computational time was decreased significantly for the matrices corresponding to the high frequencies. COCR and BICGCR converged at approximately equal numbers of iterations but COCG was a bit slower. The PARDISO solver has shown no benefit over all considered iterative solvers.

articleTitle: Method of Building a Hexagonal Grid
publicationTitle: 2021 XV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems Of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Let there is an image with some object made up of hexagons (for example, a photo of a microchannel plate). In this paper, the algorithm that builds a hexagonal grid on a photo of an object is considered. The main principle of the algorithm is detection the contour of the object. Then with the help of special geometric construction determine the coordinates of each nodal point of the hexagonal grid. The developed algorithm consists of several stages: the detection of the object edge, the corners detection on a two-dimensional curve, geometric constructions for determining the nodal points coordinates. At the same time, the widespread problem of edge detection in this case has a certain specificity. As a result of which a special algorithm for contour selection for this particular task was developed. The algorithm was also tested in conditions of high noise and uneven illumination of the object.

articleTitle: Utilization of High Frequency Electrical Signal for Biological Tissue Ablation
publicationTitle: 2021 XV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems Of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Possibility of high frequency electrical signal utilization for biological tissue ablation is considered. High frequency generator with fixed frequency of 13.56 MHz designed by the authors was used in experiments. HF generator made it possible to use needle irradiator (made of medical steel) avoiding necessity to use closed electrical loop. Piece of a pig skin was used as a biopsy slice. Processes of burning out, resection, and coagulation were conducted. It was shown that during HF ablation the tissue heats up to 120°C. To measure the temperature in the focus of action multimeter CEM DT-898 (made in FRG) with thermovision function was used. The multimeter ensured area monitoring with maximum temperature at the point of discharge occurring when the antenna was approaching the skin, the discharge also heated the skin to temperatures enough for thermal ablation. It was found that HF ablation does not affect tissue located near the focus of action. This conclusion was deduced from the dependence of skin electrical resistance on the distance from the cut after HFA. Based on the results it is recommended to use HF generators for biological tissue ablation.

articleTitle: Features of Minigrid Operation Control Based on a Small Generation Power Plant with an External Power Grid
publicationTitle: 2021 XV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems Of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The article studies the features of the Minigrid operation which formed on the basis of local power supply systems with small generation power plants. These systems can operate on renewable energy sources (solar and wind power plants) forming a Minigrid DC network with storage devices and converters and it connects to the external electrical network through frequency converting devices. Also these systems can operate on carbon fuel (mainly natural gas and water-coal fuel), energy generated from the disposal of associated gases and fuel waste (industrial and domestic waste). However, in this case systems uses a Minigrid AC network connected to the external electrical network of the high power system in a mode with synchronous connection. The results of the research and automation system development are presented. The automation system is designed to solve a technical challenge of safe connection and ensuring the parallel Minigrid operation the general electrical network during the implementation of technological and emergency control.

articleTitle: Synthesis of the Control System for the Voltage Stabilization Unit of the Three-Stage Synchronous Generator
publicationTitle: 2021 XV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems Of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The article considers the generation system based on a three-stage synchronous generator for a wide class of aircraft. For such system the device is needed that would regulate the current of the exciter excitation winding when the stator current of the main generator changes. The voltage of the exciter is the power supplying voltage of such a device. The voltage of the exciter does not depend on the mode and operating conditions of the main generator but the voltage level of the exciter is usually higher than the voltage level that is maximally necessary to power the excitation winding of the exciter. Thus, the semiconductor step-down converter is needed to regulate this voltage. Modern trends in the aircraft industry are aimed at increasing the level of electrification and digitalization of on-board equipment. Thus, it is advisable to consider the design of a digital voltage stabilization unit under the control of a microprocessor system. The analysis and calculation of the total time constant for a three-stage synchronous generator is carried out. Based on the obtained data, the synthesis of a two-circuit system of subordinate control of a semiconductor converter is carried out. The control system is designed to stabilize the output voltage in accordance with GOST for aviation power supply systems. The parameters of the control system regulators are calculated and tested on the mathematical model.

Author Keywords: time constant of an electric generator

articleTitle: Algorithm for Efficient Estimation of the Critical Current of the SIS-type Josephson Junctions
publicationTitle: 2021 XV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems Of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Digital algorithms for checking the functionality and measuring critical current of SIS-type Josephson junctions are proposed, taking into account the features of measurements under conditions of fluctuation noise and suitable for implementation in an automatic mode. A piecewise line approximation of the voltage-current characteristic is used following the typical voltage-current characteristic. To obtain the essential statistical information about the random component of the measurement results, the excitation of the Josephson junction by a periodic testing sequence of triangular current pulses was used. For a workable Josephson junction, there is a voltage jump in the vicinity of the critical current for each rising slope of the exciting pulses. The statistics of the threshold crossings on each pulse rising slope of the test pulse sequence are used to estimate the critical current. An efficient estimate of the critical current was obtained by using the maximum likelihood method. The results of statistical modeling confirm the correctness of using this method in the study of superconducting structures. The use of statistical methods makes it possible to improve technical control during serial production of Josephson junctions and debug the appropriate manufacturing technology.

articleTitle: The Least Squares Method Application for the Global Navigation Satellite Systems Signals Power Measuring
publicationTitle: 2021 XV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems Of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The global navigation satellite systems signals are widely used in the modern society life. One of the most important navigation signals characteristics is their power on the Earth surface. FSUE “VNIIFTRI” carries out regular power measurements using large-aperture dish antenna systems. The structure of navigation signals becomes more complex, code division signals are going to be implemented into GLONASS. Signals spectra with different types of separation could be overlapped, which makes it impossible to measure signal powers directly and separately. For this reason, a new method for measuring the signals power has been proposed and investigated. The method consists of determining the coefficients for normalized spectral power density functions of each signal, which are known a priori, as a result of a linear equations system solution. Modern signal analyzers make it possible to obtain a large amount of measuring data. Therefore, the system turns out to be overdetermined. To solve such a system, the least squares method is used. The individual signal powers are then calculated using the calculated coefficients and the total band power measurements. Results of methodological error evaluating the for various navigation signals carrier frequencies are presented.

articleTitle: Confidence Intervals for Identification Parameters of Heat Exchange Processes in Aircraft Instrument Compartments
publicationTitle: 2021 XV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems Of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Uncertainty of estimating the parameters of the aircraft compartments heat exchange mathematical model requires the use of a joint confidence region for estimating the model parameters. The joint confidence regions of parameter estimates describe in the model parameter space the r- dimensional ellipsoid with the center in the vector of the model parameters actual values, where <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$r$</tex> is the number of model parameters. In the case of a large dimension of the parameter vector, the use of the joint confidence region is associated with computational difficulties. Therefore, conditional joint confidence intervals of each required parameters are introduced in the form of projections of the joint confidence region on the corresponding coordinate axes of the parameter space, which is equivalent to replacing the elliptical region by the parallelepiped circumscribed around it. In recent two or three decades, with the emergence of a powerful supercomputer technology, new possibilities for the numerical solution of the time-consuming tasks, including multidimensional ones, have opened up. Due to the fact that the Monte-Carlo methods are parallelized with a good measure of effectiveness and compared with other methods they are far less sensitive by labor intensity to the dimension of problems increase, they become more competitive. In particular, multi-dimensional problems for parabolic equations on the basis of probabilistic concepts of their decisions can be solved by the method of statistical modeling. Among other things, it is possible to solve inverse problems of the thermal state of the aircraft fuselage honeycomb core and grid constructions using the parabolic boundary value problem with discontinuous coefficients basing on the numerical solution of stochastic differential equations with the use of derivatives assessments on the expected functional parameters of the diffusion processes.

articleTitle: AC Voltage Stabilizer for Overload and Overvoltage in Low-Voltage Networks
publicationTitle: 2021 XV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems Of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The trends in the development of the modern world of electricity consumption in the industrial and residential sectors are in the using of cheap and uninterrupted power supply. The necessity for regulation, stabilization, improvement of the quality of AC voltage is relevant for all AC networks and especially for rural networks under uneven distribution of consumers. This paper presents an analysis of the structural diagram, a description of the principles of operation and a mathematical calculation of the electrical processes of the AC voltage regulator, as well as simulation modeling in MatLab / Simulink The proposed AC voltage converter is a transformerless one. By adjusting the output voltage level, it is possible to achieve stabilization of the load voltage when the supply network deviates from the standards of GOST, as well as to compensate for reactive power and improve electromagnetic compatibility. Open-loop and closed-loop control algorithms for the converter have been developed.

articleTitle: Coupling of Vector and Scalar Boundary Element Methods
publicationTitle: 2021 XV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems Of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The vector boundary element method is a tool applied to solve electromagnetic problems in a media for which eddy currents must be taken into account. It's also known as the boundary element method for eddy current problems. The use of this method brings certain difficulties, one of which is the problem of zero wave number in the subdomains adjacent to the domain where the eddy currents should be considered. To mitigate the computational difficulty, we use the coupling with the scalar potential. The scalar boundary element method for the Laplace equation is in use for the corresponding adjacent subdomains with zero wave number and the associated scalar potential. In this paper, we present the system of variational equations written in a weak form and based on the Steklov-Poincare operators formulated for both scalar and vector boundary element methods. This coupling is supported with a simple test problem considering a conducting cube and a time-harmonic source of electromagnetic field.

articleTitle: Effect of Phase Noise on Pulsed Signals in a DWDM Optical Transmission System Using Coherent Detection
publicationTitle: 2021 XV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems Of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The self-phase modulation, cross-phase modulation and amplified spontaneous emission noise combined effect on pulsed signals to be transmitted of multichannel wavelength division multiplexing optical fiber transmission system is investigated. The investigation is carried out under the conditions of transmitting system parameters variation: the total optical power level in optical fiber and the linear code type. The investigation results are obtained by using analytical model of pulsing signals transmission through standard single-mode fiber in dense wavelength division multiplexing optical fiber transmission system using coherent detection. The analytical model is implemented in the environment MathCAD modeling. The estimate criterion of pulsed signals noise immunity is Q-factor to be calculated by photodetected pulsed signals eye diagram analyze. The dependence of total Q-factor value on total optical power level in optical fiber for “return to zero” and “nonreturn to zero” linear codes is demonstrated.

articleTitle: Power-On Reset IC Module with Brownout Detection and Fast Transients Immunity
publicationTitle: 2021 XV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems Of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: This work represents a custom high-speed power-on reset IC module (hard IP-core) with a supply voltage brownout detection and supply voltage fast transients immunity. This module could be incorporated in digital or mixed IC with supply voltage of 1.65 … 2 V, temperature range of -55 … 125°C. The typical features are stable switching thresholds of 1.52 V and 1.42 V, active reset time of 0.4 ms, independence on process, supply voltage and temperature. Unique features are independence on supply voltage change rate and immunity to supply voltage noise and glitches down to 70% of the rated voltage and a duration less than 10 μs, The module has been designed in 0.18 <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\mu\mathrm{m}$</tex> SiGe BiCMOS technology without using bipolar devices; therefore, it has classic CMOS structure with the ability to different compatible technology implementation. IC module has dimensions of 176 <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\mu\mathrm{m}\ \mathrm{x}102\mu \mathrm{m}$</tex>, and static power consumption of less than 25 <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\mu \mathrm{W}$</tex>.

articleTitle: Intelligent Mobile Hardware-Software Device for Automated Testing and Monitoring of Computer Networks Based on Raspberry Pi
publicationTitle: 2021 XV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems Of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: This paper describes an intelligent hardware-software device for testing enterprise and SOHO networks based on Raspberry Pi single-board computers. The device is designed to carry out primary or standard tests primarily by users who are not specialists in the field of computer network security audit or in the field of information security in general, as well as who do not have specific skills in working with applications having a command line interface. An algorithm has been created and implemented for intelligent processing of messages of the formal language of utilities for testing the security of computer networks (the Nmap utility was taken), which analyzes these messages according to specific (technical) and linguistic criteria and generates explanations, recommendations and instructions to ensure a timely response in case of vulnerabilities and high risks. The corresponding set of programs has been created for a specially assembled and configured hardware and software device. The user manual has been created too.

articleTitle: Compact GLONASS Band-Pass Filter Based on Waveguide with Resonance Membranes
publicationTitle: 2021 XV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems Of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: In this article the compact band-pass filters constructions with low losses for L1 and L2 GLONASS frequency bands are presented. The developed filters are based on rectangular waveguide with resonance waveguide-slot membranes. The frequency characteristics of the researched filters are presented. The insertion losses of the filter for L1-band (1.593–1.61 GHz) is no more than 0.576 dB, the reflection coefficient level doesn't exceed −19.3dB. The insertion losses of the filter for L2-band (1.237–1.254 GHz) is no more than 1.073 dB, the reflection coefficient level doesn't exceed 19.4dB. The developed filters behavior in frequency band 1–5 GHz was considered. The filter for L1 band has wide sideband, it is from 3.57 GHz to 4.96 GHz with center frequency 4.27GHz. A filter band-pass flatness is 0.446 dB. The filter for L2 band has some narrow sidebands. The developed filters based on waveguide with waveguide-slot membranes have low losses in operating bands, small size, production manufacturability and can be widely used in GLONASS/GPS navigation systems.

articleTitle: Characteristics Investigation of the Cold Plasma Jet Generation for Minimally Invasive Treatment
publicationTitle: 2021 XV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems Of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The research of the generation parameters of a cold plasma jet for minimally invasive treatment on biological objects has been carried out. The change in the target temperature in the zone of interaction with the cold plasma jet for various generation parameters is investigated. It has been shown that plasma jet exposure causes an increase in the target temperature, which can exceed 50 °C, which is dangerous for living tissues. Methods for reducing target heating have been developed, including the method of pre-cooling the gas, generation of a cold plasma jet in a helium He and oxygen 02 gas mixture, and current pulse duration limitation. These methods made it possible to reduce the achievable target temperature by 20-50%. The parameters of cold plasma jet generation in microchannel tubes for possible integration of the plasma jet source and laparoscopic equipment are investigated. Optimal modes of operation of a modified generation device using microchannel tubes were determined.

articleTitle: Verification Modeling of Magnetic Field Influence on Power Transmission Line Losses
publicationTitle: 2021 XV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems Of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The article is devoted to the problem of a magnetic field influence in overhead power transmission line load-bearing structure and methods of its research. The research purpose is to develop a methodology for determining the induction current effect on power transmission line loss. In theory, three-phase three-wire AC power transmission line produces the magnetic field that affects the symmetry of the voltage. To find the flux linkage with research object, a calculation was performed using the Poisson equation for vector magnetic potential. The symmetrical components method is used to calculate power losses in the asymmetric mode, considering losses in the ground. To verify the study results, physical and computer modeling of a real object was performed. For results confirmation, it was decided to find out a mutual inductance coefficient. The oscilloscope obtained by a small-scale physical model has a convergence with ratio error equal 1.4 %. The results of modeling are compared in discussion. The research can be useful in the design and modernization of overhead power transmission lines.

articleTitle: The Features of Production Systems Modeling
publicationTitle: 2021 XV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems Of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The article considers the solution of one of the main tasks of modern mechanical engineering which is the modeling of modern production systems in the field of engineering. The choice of type of production system model is considered. It is shown that from the systematological point of view all existing models are divided into imitation (portrait) and optimization, and the problem of production systems designing belongs to the class of weakly structured problems. Consequently, at the stage of macro-design it is advisable to use optimizing models rather than imitation models. An expanded definition of technological process as a set of production design, technological process design of the sequence of form-building products, manufacturing is given. The concept of production flexibility and production system adaptation to changing conditions is defined. These solutions can be used both in production automation, and in the development of computer-aided design and modeling systems, flexible production systems, and also fully meet the goals and objectives of procedia engineering.

articleTitle: Reliability of Optical Cable under Gradual Failures Taking into Account the Degree of Fiber Degradation
publicationTitle: 2021 XV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems Of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The article discusses a method for calculating the availability factors of optical fiber under conditions of reliable control of the technical state of the system. In the simulation, in addition to latent gradual failures, the aging degradation of the optical fiber is taken into account. The matrix method is used to calculate the system reliability indicators. The presented Markov model of the system is implemented by means of computer modeling. Based on the calculation results, the types of systems with a certain set of reliability characteristics, which require taking into account the intensity of damage accumulation in optical fiber as a result of degradation in their modeling, are determined. The article also considers the dependence of the maximum allowable load on the optical fiber on such variables as the value of the critical value of the probability of fiber destruction, accepted by the owner of the infrastructure, and the desired time of the optical fiber operation until reaching the critical value of the probability of fiber destruction. Restricting the load on the optical fiber within the maximum allowable value will ensure the required lifetime of the optical fiber.

articleTitle: Nonlinear Scattering of Narrowband and Ultra- Wideband Signals at Equal Peak Intensity
publicationTitle: 2021 XV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems Of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The nonlinear scattering of an RF -pulse and an ultra-wideband monocycle is compared on an example of the model consist in the short magnetic dipole and the diode. The scatterer model is built in the form of an electrical equivalent circuit and reflects the SPICE parameters of the diode, the inductance of the magnetic dipole, and the differentiating properties of the dipole due to its short length. The studies were carried out at equal peak power of the sounding signals and with equal frequencies of the amplitude spectra maximum. The nonlinearity of scattering for an RF -pulse was determined by the second harmonic, and for an ultra-wideband pulse - from the difference of the responses to two pulses with different polarity. For both the low- and high-capacitance diode, it is shown that the amplitude of the nonlinear scattering products for the ultrawideband signal is one to two orders of magnitude greater than for RF -pulse signal. This will give a corresponding increase in the detection range of the nonlinear radar only due to the transition to the baseband pulse nonlinear radar principle.

articleTitle: Application of Support Vector Machines to the Multiclass Classification Electromyography Signal Patterns
publicationTitle: 2021 XV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems Of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: In this work, a machine learning method called support vector machine is applied. This method is one of the most powerful and flexible methods for classifying hand gesture patterns based on electromyography signals. Electromyography signals research were conducted in this paper. These signals were recorded by Myo Armband bracelet. A multiclass classification of four hand gesture patterns was carried out, based on a support vector machine. These gestures were “rock”, “scissors” “paper” from a child's game, and the gesture “ok”. Also, the research on the kernel choice for the support vector machine, and the hyperparameters to it was carried out. The researched kernels were “linear”, “sigmoid”, “radial basis function” and “polynomial”. To evaluate the obtained classifiers, a confusion matrix was built and metrics were calculated such as: precision, recall, f- score. The best result was a second-order polynomial kernel with a regularization parameter equal to 2. The precision of this method is more than 90%.

articleTitle: Optimization of Testing Intervals in the Conditions of Optical Fiber Periodic Predictive Control
publicationTitle: 2021 XV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems Of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Using the fiber-optic communication lines as a guide medium for access networks makes it possible to provide broadband communications, which is necessary in the digital economy. Along with such an indicator of the quality of communication as the speed of information transmission, reliability indicators are widely used. The article discusses the influence of the testing time interval on reliability indicators during periodic predictive monitoring of the fiber-optic communication line state. In particular, the influence of the control period interval and the testing time interval on the unavailability factor of the fiber-optic communication link is investigated. In this case, models of Markov and semi-Markov processes are used to describe the state of the optical line in time. The expressions that allow estimating the optimal ratio between the control period and the testing time on the period that provides the required level of the reliability indicator of the fiber-optic communication link are given.

articleTitle: Bipolar Transistor DC LNA Characterization at 77 K
publicationTitle: 2021 XV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems Of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: In the paper DC low-noise amplifier based on commercial silicon SSM2212 transistors and operating at 77 K are described. The amplifier circuit is a differential stage with one of the arms grounded. Its characteristics, depending on the amplifier operating current, are measured. The schemes for measuring the main parameters of the amplifier are described and the following characteristics are obtained: transfer function, input voltage and current noise densities (less than 0.4 nV/H<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">z</inf>1/2 and about 5 pA/Hz1/2 at 10 kHz, respectively). For the voltage noise, the flicker noise threshold frequency is increased to 20 Hz at 77 K. Based on the results obtained, the amplifier input resistance and some parameters of the bipolar transistor hybrid-π noise model are estimated. In addition, the optimal resistance of the signal source is estimated to obtain the minimum noise figure. The obtained results have shown the suitability of commercially available bipolar transistors for cryogenic applications and could be used to optimize a custom readout system using a cryogenic amplifier based on this type of bipolar transistor.

articleTitle: The Program for Finding Alternatives to Managing the Metrological Support of an Enterprise
publicationTitle: 2021 XV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems Of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The article describes the main functions of the metrological service at the enterprise. In order to determine the management strategy of the metrological support of the enterprise and for an objective assessment of its reliability and the factors leading to metrological failure of measuring instruments, a statistical analysis was carried out. The problem of managing the reliability of metrological support is revealed, on the basis of which the objective function and methodology for finding the optimal management strategy - the search for the optimal alternative in conditions of uncertainty is proposed. The criteria for choosing the optimal alternative (Wald, Savage, Hurwitz and Laplace) are described, a decision-making matrix, 3×4 is constructed. Three management strategies are proposed: closed-loop control strategy; a strategy with optimally openable feedback; open loop strategy. To automate this task, a software application has been created, the interface of which is presented in the article. The conclusion and the purpose of further research in this subject area are formulated.

Author Keywords: criteria for choosing alternatives under uncertainty

articleTitle: Effectiveness Research of the Apriori Algorithm Implementations as Part of the Recommendation System
publicationTitle: 2021 XV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems Of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The article presents a comparison of the author's implementation of the Apriori algorithm with implementation presented in the Accord.NET library. A comparison of various parallel implementations of this algorithm is also shown. The main objective of the article is evaluating the efficiency of the Apriori affinity analysis algorithm implementation by the speed of creating an association rules list. The results of testing on the data provided by the company “FB Consult” are given. The test results show an increase in performance of the optimized parallelized implementation by about 5.28 times compared to the implementation from Accord.NET. This article clearly shows that optimization of the algorithm in order to reduce the running time by using binary vectors and operations on them gives more significant speedup than parallelization. Whereas when parallelizing, attention should be paid to the computation of support for association rules, because based on the results of this function, most of the association rules will be eliminated.

articleTitle: The Software Development for 5G New Radio Coverage Planning
publicationTitle: 2021 XV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems Of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: A customer's needs for wideband wireless network connection are increasing every year. A fifth generation of cellular networks is actively expanding and growing. The 5G New Radio reveal a wide range of new services are introduced. Mostly, in some cases they are working on variable frequencies, from 0.5 to 100 GHz. To provide a convenient Quality of Service an operators and vendors are facing a problem with accurate coverage planning process. With the carrier frequency variety 5G could provide a lot of different possibilities for cell range. The software providing a solution for coverage planning automation and visualization is developed. The solution is capable to get the Earth surface properties (like mountains, hills, plains etc.), an information about locality (number of floors, floor height, street properties, parks, etc.). The information is useful for channel model selection and radio propagation models correction. The software is able to visualize the data on actual map. The result shows more accurate and graphically convenient coverage planning dimensioning than theoretical predictions.

articleTitle: A Study of the Calibration Method for Receiver's GNSS
publicationTitle: 2021 XV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems Of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The evolution of global navigation satellite systems has formed a tendency towards the creation of methods for determining coordinates and time using multi-frequency navigation observations. This made it necessary to estimate the GNSS signals delays in receivers and satellites. This signal delays are considered constant in time and dependent on the frequency of the navigation signal. This circumstance makes it difficult to estimate the signal delays in the receiver for GLONASS. Currently, the GLONASS system uses frequency division of signals. It also complicates the monitoring of the Earth's ionosphere using GLONASS signals. Therefore, it is necessary to estimate such signal delays in satellites and receivers. There is a way to calibrate GNSS receivers using a signal simulator. Calibration is carried out in laboratories. But for receivers in hard-to-reach areas (for example, the Arctic and Antarctica), this calibration method is not suitable. Therefore, a method is needed to calibrate the receiver to GNSS signals. This paper describes the estimating delays problem of receiver navigation signals from GNSS observations. The conditions and methods of processing observations to estimate such delays are also considered.

articleTitle: Noise Immunity of Multilevel Pulse-Modulated Signals Propagating along a Dispersive Optical Path
publicationTitle: 2021 XV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems Of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: A fiber-optic transmission system for multi-level pulse amplitude modulated signals with direct photodetection on the receiving side is considered. A mathematical model for the transmission of M-level PAM signals through the dispersion optical path based on the Gaussian approximation of the transmitted pulses has been developed. The criterion of the noise immunity evaluation is the narrowing of the eye closure in the receiver. Formulas that allow estimating the power penalty due to fiber dispersion, depending on the levels, duration and duty cycle of optical pulses, as well as the parameters of the optical fiber are derived. Comparative estimates of the noise immunity of transmission PAM −4 and PAM-2 signals with bit rates of 12.5 Gbps, 25 Gbps, 50 Gbps, 100 Gbps, 200 Gbps, 400 Gbps over a standard optical fiber at a wavelength of 1550 nm are given. In comparison with the transmission of PAM-2 signals, the use of PAM-4 signals is preferable at a signal transmission rate of more than 25 Gbit/s and power penalties of more than 2.5 dB, provided that the bit error correction technology is used in the transceiver equipment, which halves the bandwidth requirements for optoelectronic components.

articleTitle: Creation of a Starting Model of the Reservoir Based on a Set of Well Data
publicationTitle: 2021 XV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems Of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: An approach to creating a starting model of a reservoir system based on a set of well data is considered. At the first stage, a skeleton of the reservoir system is formed, consisting of depth marks at the locations of the wells. The created wireframe is used to construct sub-horizontal surfaces that describe the boundaries of layers. For this purpose, the apparatus of smoothing splines with a special regularizing additives is used. Consideration of local reservoir heterogeneities is carried out using two types of contours, the vertical boundaries of which are set in template coordinates, and the lateral constraints are set by the cells of the Voronoi diagram. At the final stage, the heights of the reservoir system surfaces are corrected to correspond oil-water contact. The research results obtained for the model of real field showed that the use of smoothing splines to construct the surfaces of layers leads to extremely insignificant deviations from the depth marks and true thicknesses of these layers at the locations of the wells. It was also shown that it is possible to correctly approximate both the near-wellbore and interwell space of the model using a set of contours that define material and saturation inhomogeneities. Also, the application of the procedure for transforming the boundaries of the reservoir system in order to provide correct oil-water contact practically did not change the oil reserves in the reservoir.

articleTitle: Modeling Solar Power Station Based on a Multifunctional Integrated Electromagnetic Component
publicationTitle: 2021 XV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems Of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The computer model of a solar power plant based on a multifunctional integrated electromagnetic component has been developed. This model consists of rectifier-inverter blocks, a battery and a load. The main tasks of modeling are the study of matching the area of photovoltaic modules with the parameters of voltage and current, the choice of the most effective option for the capacity of storage batteries and the type of solar cells. Computer simulation was performed in the MATLAB Simulink. The scientific novelty of the research is expressed in the application of functional integration methods when creating a rectifier-inverter unit. The multifunctional integrated electromagnetic element is used as a resonant transformer of the rectifier-inverter unit to increase the efficiency and to reduce weight and dimensions. The use of functional integration makes it possible to reduce the amount of resources spent on the manufacture of a rectifier-inverter unit.

articleTitle: Investigation of Microwave Filters Based on Multimode Resonators
publicationTitle: 2021 XV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems Of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Multimode microwave resonators with a rectangular strip conductor split at one end and grounded to the base at the opposite end, as well as ultra-wideband bandpass filters based on them, were studied by means of numerical electrodynamic analysis of their three-dimensional microstrip models. When calculating amplitude-frequency characteristics of all microwave devices, monolithic substrates with a high dielectric constant <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\varepsilon=80$</tex> (microwave material - TBNS ceramics) were used. It is shown that in multimode resonator, the folding of a strip conductor in the form of a meander is accompanied by additional resonances to its passband. It is possible to organize an additional channel of power passage in the considered resonators, which significantly improves their selective properties. There is also a possibility to implement ultra-wideband bandpass filters with a relative bandwidth of at least 100% based on the proposed multimode microstrip resonators. Filters can be designed using both one resonator and several counter-directional resonators in the device. All synthesized microwave structures are given with constructive dimensions.

articleTitle: Receiver Differential Code Biases of GLONASS FDMA Signals with the Same Frequency Slot
publicationTitle: 2021 XV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems Of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: At present, many researchers have discovered the effect of different receiver bias in GPS signals for different receivers. These differences cannot be explained by the group delay time in the receiver circuitry. It can be explained by the influence of the navigation signal shape distortion on the bias. The effect does not appear in case of an ideal signal, but if there are some distortions - then additional differential code biases may appear, which depends on the receiver circuitry and signal processing algorithm. Thus, this additional component may change even if only the receiver firmware is changed. The article shows a similar phenomenon for GLONASS signals. The research of differential code biases for the set of different receiver models based on real GLONASS, GPS, GALILEO signals was carried out. In the case of GLONASS, pairs of navigation satellites with the same frequency slot were studied to exclude the influence of the group delay frequency dependence in the receiver circuitry. An experiment with a synthesized signal has been carried out. It was shown that signals of different navigation satellites from one simulator are identical in terms of their shape distortion, and therefore there are no significant additional differential code biases. But comparing two different simulators, the difference due to additional differential code biases when working with signals from different simulators with different distortions can be seen. It was confirmed that receiver biases depend not only on navigation signal frequency but also on its other parameters, including distortions of modulating sequence.

articleTitle: Multiple Pseudo-Local Feedbacks for Controlling High-Order Oscillatory Objects
publicationTitle: 2021 XV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems Of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Development of the Internet of things (IoT) technologies arises many additional problems as energy harvesting. In particular, a long-time controlling object needs a device without an external power supply. The control of technical objects with a high order of mathematical model has a large difficulty if a feature of the object is a high tendency to oscillations due to the ratio of the coefficients in the model. In particular, the tendency to oscillations occurs if the object model has complex roots, or if the model has a transport delay. One such example is a model that consists of two oscillatory objects and a delay loop. Widespread controlling such an objects using a PID controller is very difficult since in the transient process in the resulting system there is a large overshoot and many oscillations. If such an object could be stabilized with additional local feedbacks, the control task would be greatly simplified, but the object does not have corresponding outputs and inputs, therefore local feedbacks cannot be used. The pseudo-local feedback approach assumes the use of virtual fragments of the object's mathematical model in the controller to form such connections that the system perceives as local ones. This paper proposed the use of several pseudo-local feedbacks to control an object with elements that increased its tendency to oscillate. The effectiveness of the proposed approach is confirmed by modeling.

articleTitle: Matrix Representation of the Fast Multipole Method of Scalar Boundary Elements
publicationTitle: 2021 XV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems Of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The fast multipole boundary element method finds applications in computer simulation used for a wide variety of electromagnetic and acoustic phenomena. FMM is a tool for the boundary element method optimization. The paper proposes a block-matrix representation of multipole operators for the fast multipole boundary element method. A modification of the FMM is proposed using such a representation of the multipole operators. One of the advantages of the offered method is that the system of linear algebraic equations occurring after its use can be solved by direct methods.
