Moreover, it is possible to use non-specialized preconditioners in iterative methods to solve SLAE. The matrix assembled in the offered method can be used to precondition the SLAE, obtained by the fast multipole boundary element method, without the proposed modification. The article describes an algorithm for a simple method to obtain the matrix form of multipole operators. A comparison of the fast multipole boundary element method without offered modification and with block-diagonal preconditioning and with the preconditioning proposed in the article is given. During the comparison, harmonics of different orders were used to construct the preconditioner. The use of the proposed method as a preconditioner makes the SLAE preconditioning for the FMM without offered modification of boundary elements relatively simple and sufficiently high quality, which accelerates the convergence of iterative methods.

articleTitle: Solving One Problem of Optimal Production and Material Flow Management of a Garment Manufacturer
publicationTitle: 2021 XV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems Of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The optimization problem of forming a production program for the needs of a small sewing enterprise is solved. The results of the search and comparative analysis of the studies carried out in the last decade, which consider similar approaches to the application of discrete optimization tools to the problem of finding a production program, are presented. The substantiation of the relevance and novelty of the research is given, which consists in the fact that a new formulation of the discrete optimization problem has been created, which would take into account all the main aspects of production activities: from the selection of suppliers to the determination of sales plans for all types of buyers and the determination of sales prices. The input data for the program have been collected and agreed, tests that have shown the effectiveness of the proposed solution have been calculated on the real data of the enterprise. Further vectors for the development of the work have been determined.

articleTitle: Acceptable Variants Formation Methods of Organizational Structure and the Automated Information Security Management System Structure
publicationTitle: 2021 XV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems Of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: To ensure comprehensive information protection, it is necessary to use various means of information protection, distributed by levels and segments of the information system. This creates a contradiction, which consists in the presence of many different means of information protection and the inability to ensure their joint coordinated application in ensuring the protection of information due to the lack of an automated control system. One of the tasks that contribute to the solution of this problem is the task of generating a feasible organizational structure and the structure of such an automated control system, the results of which would provide these options and choose the one that is optimal under given initial parameters and limitations. The problem is solved by reducing the General task with particular splitting the original graph of the automated cyber defense control system into subgraphs. As a result, the organizational composition and the automated cyber defense management system structures will provide a set of acceptable variants, on the basis of which the optimal choice is made under the given initial parameters and restrictions. As a result, admissible variants for the formation technique of organizational structure and structure by the automated control system of cyber defense is received.

articleTitle: Testing Modern Modeling and Simulation Environments on Typical Examples of Hybrid Dynamical Systems
publicationTitle: 2021 XV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems Of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Hybrid dynamical systems exhibiting both discrete and continuous behavior are a convenient way of representing complex dynamic processes. Examples are electrical power systems, electromechanical robotic arms, chemical processes, socioeconomic systems among many others. Nowadays, they are modeled and simulated in specialized environments in an automated manner. Three such modern software suites, namely ISMA 2021, OpenModelica and SimInTech, are tested on two typical examples of hybrid dynamical systems. The textual program models as well as the simulation results obtained in the three modeling and simulation environments are compared. The models composed in the first two environments turned out to be cleaner and more concise than those built in SimInTech. This is partially due to the fact that the modeling languages of ISMA 2021 and OpenModelica are declarative, whereas that of SimInTech is purely imperative. Regarding event detection, ISMA 2021 and OpenModelica have demonstrated comparable results. SimInTech does not employ an independent event detection algorithm, which affects event detection.

articleTitle: Emission Spectrum of a Diode Laser with Microwave Modulation of the Injection Current
publicationTitle: 2021 XV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems Of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Emission spectrum of a diode laser with microwave modulation of the injection current was studied. Dependences of amplitudes of low-frequency and high-frequency sidebands and carrier due to microwave modulation frequency were investigated. The dependences of the spectrum on the modulation frequency were obtained in a wide frequency range of the microwave generator, from 2.8 to 3.8 GHz. This dependences for 4 different values of the diode laser injection current were obtained: 52 mA (near the threshold), 57 mA, 62 mA and 67 mA. For different values of the injection current, a clear weakening of the oscillating nature of the amplitudes was observed, and at a current of 67 mA, a wide smooth contour was obtained covering the modulation frequency range of ~ 0.5 GHz, which significantly reduces the criteria for stabilizing the cavity length. The absolute magnitude of the amplitudes and, correspondingly, the modulation efficiency increased, that can be used for effective pumping of CPT resonances in a cell with rubidium.

articleTitle: Features of Electromechanical Interactions in MEMS with a Solid-State Energy Source
publicationTitle: 2021 XV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems Of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The work is devoted to assessing the influence of the electrophysical parameters of the electret on the electromechanical characteristics of the variable capacitor with a built-in charge. A model of the variable capacitor with a built-in charge is considered and mathematical expressions are obtained to estimate the maximum possible parameters of MEMS: the critical displacement of the movable electrode, the magnitude of the external voltage and the electret surface charge density. It is shown that the critical displacement of the movable electrode with constant parameters of the dielectric layers and the increasing charge of the electret doesn't change, while the maximum allowable value of the external voltage decreases monotonically. It has been found that as the thickness of the dielectric layers, or their relative permittivities increase the maximum allowable displacement of the movable electrode, the built-in charge, and the applied external voltage also increase. As a result, the internal field of the electret as well as the energy stored by the variable capacitor which is necessary for performing useful work rise too. It has been observed that during the converter assembly process external factors can lead to a significant decrease of the electret effective voltage.

articleTitle: On the Inapplicability of the Padé Approximation for Controlling Object Consisting of Delay Link and Integrator
publicationTitle: 2021 XV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems Of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The well-known Pade formula is used to approximate the pure delay link. By means of preliminary studies using the modeling method, it was determined that object whose model consists of a series-connected delay link and an integrator is problematic. This paper examines the possibility of using the Pade formula for calculating controllers for objects that are a series connection of an integrator and a delay link. The paper offers the results of research by modeling in the VisSim software. The method of numerical optimization in numerical simulation showed that in this case such an approximation does not effectively solve the problem. Improving the approximation accuracy by increasing the order of the approximating relation does not solve the problem. This paper analyzes the reasons for this discrepancy and proposes an original approximation formula free of these shortcomings. It is shown that the application of the proposed approximation formula makes it possible to effectively and with high accuracy solve the synthesis problem. The results of modeling a system with an exact model and with the proposed model for approximation coincide with high accuracy, which is shown by an example.

articleTitle: Oxygen Concentration Measurement in Flue Gases Using Solid Electrolyte Cells
publicationTitle: 2021 XV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems Of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The article discusses the problems of fossil fuel combustion processes to produce heat and electricity. A method of measuring oxygen in gas mixtures using the solid electrolyte cells was considered. The main designs of sensors based on these cells are presented, in which air is used as a comparative gas mixture. The analysis of the advantages and disadvantages of these sensors is carried out. A sensor design was proposed based on an oxygen solid electrolyte cell with a 100<sup>%</sup> gaseous reference medium. The design features and conditions of use of the sensor are studied. An analysis of the errors of the method for measuring the oxygen concentration in flue gases based on a cell with a 100% gaseous reference medium was carried out. The gas analyzer oxygen in the flue gases developed as a result of research. The article contains the main technical and operational parameters of the device. The gas analyzer can be used to monitor and control fuel combustion processes. A special measurement method can be applied when developing a serial gas analyzer.

articleTitle: Lightning Overvoltages Suppression for the 35-kV Cable Section Insulation with the Frequency-Dependent Device
publicationTitle: 2021 XV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems Of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Lightning strokes are considered to be the one of the most serious factor impacting the electrical equipment insulation and leading to the high overvoltage level that has to be reduced. The paper deals with the analysis of unrestricted lightning overvoltages impacting the 35-kV cable line insulation that was carried out for the case when the chopped impulse is formed as a result of the line insulation flashover. Following the preliminary results, dangerous lightning overvoltages that exceed the permitted impulse strength of the cable line insulation can occur when the overhead line with the 35-kV nominal voltage is arranged in a 110-kV line frame. In some cases, the traditional protection devices are not effective in the high-frequency overvoltage restriction. So the new method of suppression is considered for the 35-kV cable line protection. The effectiveness of the frequency-dependent device at lightning strokes is analyzed for different simulation modes and variable protection device characteristics. As a result, recommendations for the appropriate frequency-dependent device parameters are given.

articleTitle: Development of a Machine Learning Based Algorithm to Identify the Main Types of Optical Signal Transmission Faults Between a Switch and an Optical Transceiver
publicationTitle: 2021 XV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems Of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: In the article, the authors will show the results of the methodsdevelopment for testing optical transceivers and switches. The authors analyze the subject matter, give examples of the main problems encountered in real data centers that use optical transceivers. The introductory part briefly describes the main parameters affecting the quality of data transmission in optical transceivers. First of all, the authors describe the most common problems that arise during the operation of optical transceivers and switches during production and during long-term operation. In the second part, an analysis of modern methods of troubleshooting is given, examples of equipment for their search are given. A set of actions for finding errors is given as an example. In the final part, a description of the developed algorithm and conclusions about its effectiveness are given, and an analysis of the prospects for this development and plans for its implementation in real production facilities and data centers are carried out.

articleTitle: DC Power Supply System for Autonomous Objects
publicationTitle: 2021 XV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems Of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The article presents a DC power supply system based on a contactless synchronous generator with combined excitation and an uncontrolled rectifier. One of the possible options for constructing a DC power supply system for autonomous objects is described. In particular, such a power supply system can be used as an on-board power supply system for aircraft. A synchronous generator with combined excitation replaces three-stage synchronous generators, as an electric generator on board aircraft. The working magnetic flux in such a generator is created from two sources of magnetomotive force - a permanent magnet and an excitation winding. The main, as a rule, most of the working magnetic flux is created by permanent magnets, the excitation winding creates an additional, as a rule, smaller part of the flux than provides a change in the total flux and regulation in a certain range of the output voltage of the generator. Scenarios for selecting parameters and controlling a synchronous generator that ensure the stability and controllability of the system are proposed and investigated. The results obtained can be useful in the development of power supply systems for aircraft and autonomous objects.

Author Keywords: contactless synchronous generator with combined excitation

articleTitle: Variance Estimation of the GNSS-Simulator Pseudorange Generation Error
publicationTitle: 2021 XV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems Of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Usually the receiver of the global navigation satellite system is calibrated either a differential method or a simulator of the global navigation satellite system. The receiver differential calibration estimates the error of one receiver relative to another. For absolute receiver calibration uses simulator. Calibrating the receiver with a simulator gives the receiver instrumental pseudorange measurement error. Thus, the receiver pseudorange measurement error contains the simulator pseudorange generation error. The simulator pseudorange generation error of the navigation signal is due to the circuitry of the radio-frequency output and the shaper discreteness. The lower the resolution of the digital-to-analog converter of the shaper, the more it affects the random component of the pseudorange generation error. The article presented an oscilloscope method for determining the code pseudorange error of the simulator and shows the relationship between the code pseudorange variance generation by the signal simulator, measured with an oscilloscope, and the code pseudorange measurement variance by a perfect receiver.

articleTitle: Supercontinuum Generation in Cascaded Raman Conversion
publicationTitle: 2021 XV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems Of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The authors demonstrate the possibilities of supercontinuum formation due to cascaded stimulated Raman scattering in a 1-km long optical fibre with standard transverse dimensions doped with phosphorus pentoxide P2O5. For supercontinuum pumping were used noise-like pulses with variable envelope duration (35 to 150 ps) and different coherence degree (with different levels of stochastic fluctuations which corresponded to different amplitudes of the autocorrelation coherence peak). At the average pumping radiation power of 600 mW, the generated supercontinuum width reached 140 nm. Dependencies of supercontinuum properties upon the noise-like pulse parameters are also presented. It is shown that even upon significant increase of the envelope duration of double-scale pulses (from 36 to 153 ps), the efficiency of nonlinear conversion does not decrease. It is also shown that the width of the emission spectrum can reach 225 nm upon reducing the envelope duration down to 25 ps and increasing the coherence peak up to 40%.

articleTitle: Neurobayesian Algorithm for Subject's Psychophysiological State Identification
publicationTitle: 2021 XV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems Of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: At the present stage of the technology development, the reliability indicators of technical systems have increased, while the person reliability began to recede over time, therefore increasing the role of the subjective factor in the emergence of industrial accidents and incidents. In order to reduce the risk of damage made by the subject, the admission to the performance of professional tasks should be multistage and periodic (continuous). Accidents can be the consequence of subjects staying in “inadequate” psychophysiological state: alcohol intoxication, stress, drowsiness, etc. In this work, the authors offer a neuro-Bayesian algorithm for recognizing psychophysiological states of subjects using facial thermographic images, based on the use of convolutional neural networks committees and sequential application of the Bayesian hypothesis formula. More than 97% of the recognition accuracy of seven psychophysiological states has been achieved for a 10 second monitoring period, which exceeds the known world indicators both in accuracy and recognition duration.

articleTitle: Quality Control Metrics at Different Stages of Genomic Assembly in the Parallel Sequencing Using the Nanofor SPS
publicationTitle: 2021 XV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems Of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Next generation sequencing (NGS) using short reads makes a great contribution to solving the problems of modern genomics, genetics, cell biology and medicine, especially in the research of metagenomics, comparative genomics, polymorphism detection, mutation screening, transcriptomic profiling and many other applications. Unfortunately, in this case, the sequencing reliability turns out to be unstable to technical errors of the platform and a variety of biases that can influence scientific conclusions. Briefly, NGS technologies consist of creating a collection of numerous short DNA fragments, called a “library”, obtaining molecular colonies and their subsequent massive parallel sequencing. Such sequenced fragments are called “reads”, they are collected into extended lines (scaffolds). These longer nucleotide sequences are then assembled into genomes for further analysis. The first Russian parallel sequencing sequencer Nanofor SPS is being created at the Institute of Analytical Instrumentation of the Russian Academy of Sciences. To assess the capabilities of this device similar to it for use in various studies in medicine, biology and other industries, it is very important to verify the reliability of genetic analysis. For this, it is necessary to provide quality control metrics, which are considered in this work.

Author Keywords: assess the quality of NGS data

articleTitle: Computer Simulation of Computational and Measurement Processing of Gravimetric Data
publicationTitle: 2021 XV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems Of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The paper proposes the computational algorithm for solving the inverse problem of exploratory gravimetry, consisting in the separability of two isolated bodies that generate anomalies of the measured magnitude of the gravitational force. It is based on the use of the results of multi-level measurements of the gravitational field vertical component. The obtained data of gravity measurements at two levels are converted into numerical values of the gravitational field strength in directions (azimuths). It allows to solve the inverse localization problem for isolated inhomogeneities. This article presents a numerical method for solving the isolation problem. An algorithm for solving the problem of separability of bodies with excessive density is proposed, based on the method of finding the sum of the vectors of the gravitational field strength along the azimuths of the directions between points at two levels of gravity measurement. The vectors of balancing directions determined in this way give a qualitative solution to the inverse problem of separability of test bodies. The quantitative characteristics of inhomogeneities are refined by varying the position (geometric parameters) of the test bodies, as well as the densities of the host rocks and bodies that generate gravitational anomalies. Minimizing the norm of the residual functional of empirical data - the results of stratified measurements and calculated values of the gravitational force for varied data at the measurement levels gives a quasi - solution - the parameters of the optimal location of the test bodies of the assumed shape.

articleTitle: Electricity Meters Testing Risks
publicationTitle: 2021 XV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems Of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Product quality testing should be effective. It is necessary to minimize the risks of making erroneous decisions. During testing, errors of the 1-st kind (a suitable product is rejected) and the 2-nd kind (an unsuitable product is mistakenly accepted) can occur. Quality indicators of mass-produced products testing are the risks for customers and manufacturers. The risks assessment accuracy depends on several factors. It is proposed to use the upper confidence limits of the indicated risks when developing and certifying control methods. It was proposed to find these confidence limits and requirements for the measurement accuracy during control by the Monte Carlo method. The advantage of this method is the ability to obtain numerical results without performing a physical experiment or complex analytical calculations. Quantitative estimates of desired risks of making erroneous decisions when testing electric meters are obtained. Due to this method, it is possible to investigate the dependence of these risks on the volume of the products controlled sample considering the measurement results uncertainty. The method also allows the reasonable establishment of “control” tolerances to ensure the test results required validity.

articleTitle: Knowledge and Data Integration in the Tasks of Technogenic Noise Environmental Monitoring
publicationTitle: 2021 XV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems Of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The paper is devoted to the problem of integrating knowledge and data in the field of geo-ecology. The study of anthropogenic noise impact dependence on various objects on natural factors complex is an important component of forecasting geo-ecological risks. The geo-ecological risk assessment methodology has been developed at ICM&MG SB RAS, in which a low-frequency seismic vibrator is used as an instrument. Vibration sources provide stable emission of seismoacoustic signals with specified parameters, which allows them to be used as test signals. The paper considers the aspects of the development of the scientific information system “Active seismology”, into which the experimental data of geo-ecological monitoring of technogenic noise were integrated, and the Knowledge Portal, which provides navigation and meaningful access to information resources of the subject area. The article also discusses an approach to building information systems on the Internet in which access to data and knowledge in a subject area is organized on the basis of ontologies.

articleTitle: Strain-Sensing Properties of Chitosan-Based Film Composites
publicationTitle: 2021 XV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems Of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The paper is devoted to strain-sensing properties of biopolymer composite film materials based on chitosan matrix with few-layered graphene as electrically conductive filler particles. The composite films were made by flow-coating method of colloidal dispersions of few-layered graphene in solution of chitosan in water and lactic acid with polyvinylpyrrolidone or pluronic F108 as surfactants. The experimental samples about 70–100 µm in thickness were made with few-layered graphene content of 3% and 4% (wt.) for the composites with polyvinylpyrrolidone and 2 %, 3 %, 4 % and 5% (wt.) with pluronic F108. Electrical resistivity changed from 0.016 to 1300 Ohm-m depending on surfactant and few-layered graphene content. The samples were shown to have strain-sensing properties, the strain gauge factor to be from 1.3 to 5.7 depending on the filler content and surfactant used. The strain-sensing properties were studied with beams of uniform strength (in bending), the composites bonded to them with cyanoacrylate glue. The composites are perspective as strain gauges for health monitoring due to their biocompatibility.

articleTitle: The Mandelstam - Brillouin Backscatter Spectrum Profile Evaluation in Optical Fibers of Various Types
publicationTitle: 2021 XV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems Of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The research results of the frequency characteristics of the Mandelstam - Brillouin scattering in single-mode optical fibers are presented in this work. A method for obtaining the optical and acoustic modes distribution characteristics in single-mode optical fibers is considered. The procedure for determining the profile of the Mandelstam - Brillouin back scatter spectrum with known structure of single-mode optical fibers is shown. The examples are given of obtaining the characteristics of acoustic and optical modes for the dispersion-shifted optical fiber (Recommendation ITU- T G.653) based on the analysis of the acousto-optical interaction. Also the contribution of each acoustic mode to the final Mandelstam-Brillouin back scatter spectrum of the reflected in the backward direction light signal is determined. The profiles of the Mandelstam - Brillouin scatter spectrum of usual single-mode optical fiber (Recommendation ITU- T G.652) and dispersion-shifted optical fiber (G.653) obtained during experimental research with “ANDO AQ8603” BOTDR are presented.

articleTitle: Information System for Ergonomic Assessment of a Perspective Maneuverable Aircraft Cockpit
publicationTitle: 2021 XV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems Of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The article is devoted to the ergonomic assessment of the crew workplaces of a promising maneuverable aircraft using the information system developed for these purposes. The assessment is based on a variety of human-machine-environment ergonomic indicators. The article provides description of the main groups of ergonomic indicators, discusses methods for the indicators assessment. The article discusses the use of an information system consisting of a database containing information on the ergonomic parameters of the developed workplaces of the crew of a promising maneuverable aircraft, and software for processing this information. The structure of the database is considered, methods of obtaining an integral ergonomic estimate are described. The analytical hierarchy process method is used as a method for obtaining an integral ergonomic assessment of the crew's workplaces; the article provides a general scheme of the method. The paper provides a general description of approaches to the design of the logical and physical structure of various database parts.

articleTitle: Synthesis of a Controller for a System with a Delay
publicationTitle: 2021 XV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems Of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The task of controlling some systems is complicated due to the fact that real technical plants may contain delay links. That is, there is a certain time period when there is no reaction from the regulated plant to the control action. Usually, the delay link presence negatively affects the quality of such system management. There are various ways to synthesize a control system for such systems. These include: Smith predictors, specialized control tuning algorithms, the use of self-adjusting systems with active adaptation. However, they impose additional requirements on the system dynamics or are complex in technical implementation and configuration. Within the framework of this article, an attempt is made to calculate the controller by the polynomial method for a plant with a delay. The delay mathematical model is obtained by approximating the delay link by Pade series. To ensure the necessary dynamics of the transition process, we will require the system to preserve the poles of the delay link. Then the controller, calculated for a system with a delay link in the form of a Pade series, is applied to a system with an “ideal” delay. For clarity of the calculations carried out, an plant in the form of a aperiodic combination and integrating links connected in different ways is taken as an example. The integrating link is necessary to give the system astatic properties. As a delay, we will use the approximation of a number of Pads of different orders. The lag link gives the system an unstable character.

Author Keywords: synthesis of an automatic control system

articleTitle: Discussion of the Parameters of the Distance Learning System in Virtual Reality
publicationTitle: 2021 XV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems Of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The widespread use of virtual reality in recent years has offered researchers many new directions for research and development. One of the most important and obvious industries for the application of VR from the very beginning was education. Educational applications for VR are quite common today. The degree of immersion in the environment offered by VR, according to many authors, has a positive effect on the perception of information provided in applications. Another current trend in connection with the COVID-19 pandemic is the active transition of many institutions to distance or mixed learning. However, there are currently very few VR applications for distance learning. This article describes the possible format of such a system, as well as the requirements for it. Various aspects of the proposed system, such as financial, network, and technical, are considered. In particular, the necessary computer configuration and network parameters are described. The issues of the user interface and user security are touched upon. Possible approaches to solving these problems are proposed.

articleTitle: The Method of Experimental Evaluation of Noise Immunity and Stealth of Radio Engineering Systems with Polarization Modulation
publicationTitle: 2021 XV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems Of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The dynamics of the development of systems with polarization processing raises the question of the methods of their research. An important role in the creation and research of radio engineering systems is played by methods of semi-natural modeling, which allow conducting research and testing algorithms for the functioning of products at all stages of their development on prototypes and simulators, replacing a significant part of field tests with semi-natural modeling. The combination of full-scale and mathematical models allows us to conduct research of those situations when a full-scale experiment is not possible or its implementation requires the involvement of large resources. One of the measured parameters is noise immunity and stealth. The article presents the basics of the methodology for experimental evaluation of noise immunity and stealth of systems with polarization modulation. The structure of the stand implementing it is described, an example of using the method for comparative evaluation of noise immunity of various processing algorithms is given.

Author Keywords: measurement of parameters of radio engineering systems

articleTitle: Out-of-plane Gap Closing Electrostatic Vibration Energy Harvester
publicationTitle: 2021 XV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems Of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: This work is dedicated to experimental study of an electret-based electrostatic vibrational energy harvester with out-of-plane gap closing topology converting the mechanical vibration energy into electrical energy. It has been demonstrated that the maximal power produced by the eVEH at acceleration magnitude of 1 g is about <tex>$1.25\ \mu\mathrm{W}$</tex>. This value is reached under vibration frequency of 90 Hz and load resistance of <tex>$9\ \ \mathrm{M}\Omega$</tex>. Such value of the output power is comparable to that of other world-wide developments. The eVEH operation is studied in a pulse mode that is typical for wireless sensor networks nodes where they remain in standby mode for a long time to accumulate the converted energy. For this purpose the electronic switch with a low power consumption which can be closed after reaching a specific voltage across the storage capacitor has been implemented. It has been observed the LED luminescence at the moment of the switch closing.

articleTitle: Cloud Infrastructure for Intelligent Decision Support in Titanium Carbide Laser Cladding
publicationTitle: 2021 XV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems Of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The results of laser cladding by powder injection of titanium carbide on the surface of steel plate are presented. The dependence of tribological properties of the material created on a metal sample on the concentration of titanium carbide in a gas-powder mixture fed into a melt pool has been analyzed. It is established that the mechanical wear of ferrous-based alloy significantly increases in case of deposition of hard-alloy powder on its surface by laser cladding. In this case a linear dependence of the coating hardness increase on the deposited powder material flow rate is observed. Taking into account the complexity of laser technological equipment parameter setting and the variety of factors affecting the laser metal processing quality, the software concept for intelligent support of decision-making by the equipment operator has been proposed. The concept is based on an ontological two-level approach to the creation of databases and knowledge base of laser-based directed energy deposition additive manufacturing processes. A brief description of the information resources and tools for the decision support in laser-based additive manufacturing is given.

articleTitle: The Use of Empirical Mode Decomposition for Physiological Artifacts Suppression from Electroencephalogram Signals
publicationTitle: 2021 XV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems Of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: An electroencephalogram is a biomedical signal, which represents changes in the electrical activity of the cerebral cortex. EEG signals are widely used in clinical practice for diagnosis and monitoring of the body state. Most of the biomedical signals, including EEG signals, are low-level, so their recording process is accompanied by various interferences of physical and physiological origin. Such interferences are called artifacts. Their influence significantly distorts the useful signal, which leads to serious problems in its analysis and reduces its diagnostic potential. Moreover, a number of artifacts can not only distort the signal, making it impossible to use, but also imitate undesirable pathological activity or cause incorrect behavior of signal processing algorithms. The suppression of artifacts of physiological origin is a very difficult task. At the moment, the search for a universal and effective method for solving this task has not yet been solved and remains urgent. This paper discusses the application of Empirical Mode Decomposition and some of its modifications to suppress the main physiological artifacts of EEG signals.

articleTitle: An Investigation of the Performance of Single- and Double-Converter Parallel Active Power Filters under Various Modulation Modes
publicationTitle: 2021 XV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems Of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Active power filters are considered to be an efficient solution for compensating the disturbances of current and reactive power in three-phase power distribution networks with non-linear loads. In this article, a parallel active power filter composed of two three-level converters connected in parallel is presented. The active power filter is intended to be part of a three-phase power distribution network with a nonlinear load. The dependences of the total harmonics distortion of the phase currents on the power consumed by the load in the case of converters working under the scalar or space vector pulse width modulation are investigated. In addition, the power losses in the elements of the converters are estimated. At medium power, a double-converter active power filter is beneficial over a single-converter active power filter, providing lower total harmonic distortion values. The space vector pulse width modulation ensures better compensation of harmonics than the scalar one. At high power, single-converter active power filters cannot compensate the current harmonics. With a double-converter active power filter, compensation is successful, and the total harmonics distortion is only 5%. Importantly, at high power, the total losses in the components of a single-converter active power filter are nearly twice the losses in the components of a double-converter filter.

articleTitle: The Spectral Characteristics Research of the Voice-Speech Signal in Dysphonia
publicationTitle: 2021 XV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems Of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The object of this research is voice samples (au-dio recordings) of a person with hypotonic and hypertonic dysphonia from healthy voices. The relevance and significance of the research are ensured by the rapid growth the number of people suffering from voice disorders. The work's aim is the developing of a method for analyzing the voice through digital signal processing, allowing to differentiate objectively a voice with hypotonic dysphonia, a voice with hypertonic dysphonia and a voice in normal, taking into account its characteristic changes and violations of the phonation process. The extended acoustic analysis of children's voices recordings, obtained as a result of the experiment, was carried out in the process of work. Within the work, a method for analyzing the voice for the presence of the phonation process violations was developed, taking into account the values of noise characteristics, the type of spectral and cepstral characteristics and the parameter Cepstral Dysphonia Coefficient (CCD), which evaluates the certain pathology's presence.

articleTitle: Based Interpolation Channel Estimation for Millimeter-Wave MIMO OFDM Systems with Multibeam Luneburg Antenna
publicationTitle: 2021 XV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems Of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: An important moment for fifth generation network in the millimeter wave domain is the use of multibeam antenna. There are many multibeam antenna systems implementations. Nowadays, the most popular implementation is the one used in the massive MIMO systems, namely the uniform planar antenna array generation. However, in several parameters, such as energy consumption and implementation cost, lens antenna array can overcome the uniform planar antenna array and, furthermore, to be of potential use. Antenna configuration changing influences on not only the signal energy transmission and receive, but other system parameters as well. For example, optimal channel estimation interpolation method in the MIMO-OFDM systems based on the uniform planar antenna array and in the lens antenna array systems would be different. In the paper, the MIMO-OFDM channel estimation is based on the lens antenna array. As a multibeam lens, the spherical Lunenburg antenna is used. In order to estimate the channel in the MIMO-OFDM based on the lens antenna array with pilot-signal-test, the four interpolation methods performance is compared. The methods are as follows: linear interpolation, spline interpolation, DFT-based interpolation trigonometric interpolation, Akima spline interpolation and Lanczos interpolation.

articleTitle: Propagation Dynamics of Dark Pulses in Optical Fiber Links
publicationTitle: 2021 XV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems Of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The authors investigate nonlinear evolution of a dark pulse allocated within an arbitrary background bright pulse upon propagation in telecom optical fibers. For the first time was revealed that owing to a phenomenon partially similar to the modulation instability, a single dark pulse can evolve into a specific pulse structure - an ordered cluster of bound bright and dark pulses, when propagating in anomalous-dispersion fibers. It was shown that energy of the background pulse can be mostly transferred to the burst of bright and dark pulses under certain conditions. This evolution is governed mainly by such initial parameters as the background pulse peak power and the dark pulse duration. It can be considered as a limiting factor for fiber transmission of arbitrary optical waveforms, on the one hand, and as a promising method for ultrashort pulse bursts generation, on the other hand. The obtained bursts feature an ultrahigh (sub-THz) intraburst pulse repetition rate.

articleTitle: Algorithm for the Camera Scene 3D Model Calculation
publicationTitle: 2021 XV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems Of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Modern 3D reconstruction algorithms offer a wide range of methods and tools for building a model of the surrounding space. Most of the approaches require the use of additional equipment, such as: lidars, laser scanners, stereo cameras. At best, a video camera with high-definition resolution is required. The cost of auxiliary equipment limits the availability of these methods. In addition, using 3D reconstruction approaches for the task of obtaining a video surveillance scene leads to the problem of determining the location of the camera in the resulting model. To avoid this problem, the spatial information obtaining by the surveillance cameras itself is suggested. Since the cameras using in surveillance are usually not a stereo pairs and in a worst scenario placed without overlapping, the suggested approach is to extract the spatial information during the calibration. This article presents an algorithm for obtaining a 3D model of the camera scene using the reference points acquired during calibration.

articleTitle: Improved Dynamic of Engine Generation Set Using Energy Storage and the Instantaneous Power Theory
publicationTitle: 2021 XV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems Of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: This paper presents a comparative evaluation of two different algorithms for an Energy Storage System installed with an Engine Generation Set in an autonomous power supply system. The algorithms presented are intended to improve dynamic of the engine generation set units when a load connects or disconnects from the power supply system. All the algorithms are based on the instantaneous power theory. The main advantage of these algorithms is that they do not require any significant changes or additions to the known control system for a shunt active power filter. In fact, as shown in the article, energy storage system controlled by slightly modified algorithm based on the instantaneous power theory becomes a power system for load transients during load commutations. It is shown, that ESS provides smoother power variation using these additions to the conventional instantaneous power theory as far as active power filtering. Moreover, an ESS still may operate as an active power filter with some limitations concerning load changes. The results presented in paper are verified by simulation models.

articleTitle: Multiplied Frequency Measuring System
publicationTitle: 2021 XV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems Of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The article describes a functional diagram of a multiplied measuring system for simultaneous frequency measurement in n channels. The measuring system implements three methods of frequency measurement: the first method is to measure the frequency over an integer number of periods of the measured frequency, the second is to measure the frequency over an integer number of periods of the reference frequency, and the third is the coincidence method. The use of such a solution makes it possible to minimize the frequency measurement time and ensure a given level of sampling error. The time graphs of frequency measurement by the coincidence method obtained by statistical modeling using four pulse duty cycles are given. An expression is shown for determining the values of the pulse duty cycle, at which the shortest frequency measurement time is achieved by the coincidence method. A probabilistic estimation of the frequency measurement time by the coincidence method and a probabilistic estimation of the range of measured frequencies, in which the frequency measurement by the coincidence method is performed faster than the first two methods, are presented.

articleTitle: Massive-Parallel Algorithms for Identifying the Production Batches of Semiconductor Devices
publicationTitle: 2021 XV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems Of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The modern development of rocket and space technology sets stringent requirements for hardware developers - improving the overall spatial and weight characteristics, increasing the hardware functionality and increasing the period of active existence. The range of electronic devices used in spacecraft on-board equipment must have the following set of specific conditions: (1) a large set of tasks performed by rocket and space technology leads to the necessity of using a wide variety of electronic devices standard types with an extremely small quantitative requirement; (2) the wide electronic devices functional range requires the use of various technologies in production, many of which are unique and absent in the Russian Federation; (3) stringent requirements for the active existence period in the absence of repair opportunities lead to super-stringent requirements for reliability and resistance to outer space destabilizing factors. Due to the fact that the Russian Federation does not produce specialized electronic devices for rocket and space technology, the problems of completing on-board equipment are solved by using foreign-made electronic devices and domestically made electronic devices processed by specialized test technical centers with the total incoming control, additional screening tests, diagnostic non-destructive testing and selective destructive physical analysis. To reduce the computation time for the selection of potentially unreliable electronic products for space application, we propose parallel algorithms with a greedy agglomerative heuristic procedure for solving problems of automatic grouping with large amounts of data, adapted to the CUDA architecture.

articleTitle: Base Station Multibeam Antenna for 5G Network Based on the Lunenburg Lens Structure
publicationTitle: 2021 XV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems Of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: One of the key technologies for the novel 5G mobile communication is the millimeter-wave multiple-input multiple-output system. However, practical implementation of MIMO in the millimeter-wave is still complicated. Yet, it makes the task popular. One of the common subtasks is modeling of the antenna which is compatible of generating many beams effectively in terms of the power consumption and used radio-frequency domains. The Lunenburg lens antenna seems to be an optimal option to address the task. It gives an opportunity to form the directed beam in a wide-angular range with low impact in performance. In the paper, the multifunctional multi-layered Lunenburg lens antenna is shown. The antenna consists of the MIMO twelve primary feeds system installed around the spherical lens surface. The specific angular pattern generation by switching rectangular waveguides is presented. The installation of the special beamforming Lunenburg lens model on the traffic-lights with the vehicles around is analyzed.

articleTitle: Development of the Discrete Algorithm of Stabilizing for «Suspended Load» Model Object
publicationTitle: 2021 XV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems Of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: In this paper, the problem of developing a discrete algorithm of stabilizing for the «suspended load» model object is discussed. A system of differential equations describing the behavior of a «suspended load» object was presented, and a synthesis problem was formulated. A study of the properties of an object based on its nonlinear model has been carried out. It was proposed to divide the control action into two components, each of which solves its own problem. The stabilizing algorithm of this system based on the localization method and PD-controller was developed. A method of estimating of state vector was proposed. It was proposed to use one first-order (for carriage subsystem) and one second-order (for load subsystem) filters to find the full vector of state estimates. After that, a discrete implementation of algorithm was performed. Simulating of stabilizing system by means of Matlab Simulink integrated environment allow proving that the system works out the predetermined initial conditions in a required transient time. The stabilizing algorithm considered in this article copes with its task equally well in both continuous and discrete control systems.

articleTitle: Influence Fields Calculation in Problems of Induction Logging by the Finite Element Method
publicationTitle: 2021 XV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems Of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The paper presents the software and algorithms for solving forward problems and calculating the influence fields during the induction logging data inversion. The algorithm for the direct problem solving is based on the finite element method. Grouping the positions of the receiving-generator set was used: the same finite element mesh was built for each group. As a result, the finite element SLAEs in the group differed in the right hand side vector (in accordance with the source position). The use of the grouping increases the direct methods efficiency of SLAE solving. The P ARDISO program was used to solve the finite element SLAE. With the help of the developed software and mathematical apparatus, research were carried out to determine the minimal changes in the geoelectric medium properties (both geoelectric and geometric) that significantly (greater than the noise level) affect the signals in the receivers. The results obtained are applicable when setting the increments of the unknown parameters of the medium for calculating the influence fields by the Gauss-Newton method, as well as when analyzing the well log for setting the starting model for of the induction logging data inversion.

articleTitle: Comparative Study on The Results of Student Assessment Data Developed by SURE Model
publicationTitle: 2021 XV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems Of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The Mongolian University of Science and Technology collects information (data) related to teaching methods and learning environment using a brief questionnaire from each student each semester. The data collected via questionnaires should be used for analysis of education activities, as well as development of policy level measures directed to improve education quality and teaching methods. However, as was observed by teachers, there is still an insufficiency in development of collected data and actions taken based on the results. In order to conduct comparative study within the framework of this issue, one module was taught by the same teacher (Theoretical mechanics 2) and other three different subjects (Mathematics 1, Information Technology 1, Theoretical Mechanics 1) were chosen, which are selected by most of the students, and ultimately processed the results with the use of the SURE model of structure-based evaluation. In this article, a total of 66681 evaluation data were provided by students who completed general education courses, professional foundation courses and other specialized courses at three schools (School of Industrial Technology, School of Mechanical Engineering and Transportation, School of Information and Telecommunication Technology) under the MUST, and these data were processed with the use of evaluation model mentioned above and the results were compared with the outcomes of previous study.

articleTitle: Application of the K-Standards Algorithm for the Clustering Problem of Production Batches of Semiconductor Devices
publicationTitle: 2021 XV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems Of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The k-means algorithm has long been used to solve clustering problems in any area and for any data type. This algorithm is the classic and most common in the considered field of data analysis. K-standards lesser known and studied clustering algorithm than k-means. However, when it was studied on test data sets, as well as on real data of batches of electrical radio products, obtained by JSC “Testing Technical Center - NPO PM”, the algorithm demonstrated results no worse than the well-known algorithm, and in some cases even better. The k-means algorithm can be classified as center-oriented algorithms. Such algorithms consider a cluster as an area “close” to the center of the cluster. The k-standards algorithm belongs to the class of density algorithms, which take as a cluster the region where the density of elements from the clustering set is higher than some threshold value. Algorithms are selected specifically for different clustering assessment. Since the basis of the considered methods is a different process of cluster detection, then the results should be evaluated in different ways. In addition, due to the low popularity of the k-etalons algorithm, a conclusion was made about the quality of its work and the expediency of its use in solving problems of objects automatic grouping.

articleTitle: Pulse Picker for Generating Femtosecond Radiation with a Selectable Carrier-Envelope Phase
publicationTitle: 2021 XV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems Of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: A pulse picker has been developed to obtain a of femtosecond pulse sequence with controlled carrier-envelope phase is demonstrated. Of all possible trains, the carrier-envelope phase could be selected with a discreteness of 2.88 degrees. The repetition rate of such trains was 2 MHz, that is, every 125th pulse was extracted from the original sequence of pulses. The characteristics of the developed pulse picker that can operate at frequencies of 0.5–100 MHz made it possible to reduce the requirements for the accuracy of setting the selector phase relative to the phase of the original pulse train. The pulse picker makes it possible to obtain at the modulator output a “pure” femtosecond pulse train in a sufficiently wide range of the control signal phase tuning. A discreteness of setting the phase shift between the envelope and carrier can be reduced by increasing the ratio of the carrier frequency of the femtosecond radiation and the carrier-envelope offset.

articleTitle: Automatic Correction of Dynamic Errors in Multisensor Transducers for Detecting End Positions of Moving Objects
publicationTitle: 2021 XV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems Of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The sources of dynamic errors that reduce the reliability of functioning of multisensor transducers converting binary mechanical signals into electrical ones and result in an ambiguity of the conversion of inputs into outputs are identified. The influence of the time of switching of input signals from the state “0” to the state “1” for different initial phases of transient processes of input signals switching is considered. A general functional diagram of a 4-bit multisensor converter with a parallel fiber-optic digital-to-analog converter containing a radiation source, optical splitters, an optical switch, an optical signal generator, and a fiber-optic digital-to-analog converter is considered. A scheme is proposed for eliminating conversion ambiguity based on blocking the photo amplifier signal for the time of the transient process. A mathematical model of the auto-correction scheme for the case of exponential transient switching processes of input signals has been developed and applied for assessing dynamic characteristics of a multisensor transducer for binary signal conversion.

articleTitle: Development of a Differential Temperature Sensor for the Implementation of an Exchange Density Measuring Device
publicationTitle: 2021 XV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems Of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: By measuring the amount of heat that is emitted from the human body surface it is possible to estimate the body energy exchange with high accuracy. Disruption of energy metabolism can lead to irreversible consequences that will adversely affect the body. Therefore, in order to judge about energy exchange a heat flow is needed. At the time, monitoring of the heat loss from the body into the environment is a complex task that is not fully resolved. In this article devices and methods are used for heat flow measuring to implement a wearable device that allows to measure the intensity of energy exchange. A Wheatstone measuring bridge circuit is being developed, which together with a gas flow meter represents a heat flow sensor. Thermistors are used for achieving high accuracy and low measurement inertia. In the course of the study a circuit diagram of an experimental setup was designed. Experimental studies of individual components and the overall performance of the heat flow sensor were conducted. As a work result, the device was tested in operation and graphs were built. The graphs show significant temperature differences when comparing the inertia of thermistors and BME280 sensors. In the future, it is planned to develop a 3-D wearable model, conduct experimental studies of individual components and the overall performance of the heat flow sensor.

articleTitle: Investigation of the Stability and Frequency Properties of a Generating Complex when Operating on an Autonomous Load
publicationTitle: 2021 XV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems Of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: This paper discusses the use of modified permanent magnet synchronous generators in order to improve the controllability of the system and increase the range of operating parameters. A mathematical description of the process of operation of a power supply system built using Smart-grid technology with distributed generation, where each generating cell is a whole generating complex, which must provide the required voltage level and control of the flowing current, is presented. The work of a simulation model of an electric power supply system with a single generating complex, with control functions of an aperiodic type, is considered. The boundaries of the system parameters were established and the key indicators of the transition process and the accuracy of the system operation were evaluated. Recommendations are also formulated for further improvement of the system, which will be aimed at improving the quality indicators of the transition process of nodes and the whole system.

articleTitle: Matrix Simulator of Echo Signals of Three Antenna Radar Systems
publicationTitle: 2021 XV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems Of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The article discusses matrix simulators used to simulate echo signals of three-antenna radar systems. The problem is that the issues of using matrix simulators for multiantenna systems are poorly understood. It is necessary to use such configurations that would provide adequate simulation simultaneously for all reception channels of the multi-antenna radar. This work presents a development of the results obtained for two-antenna systems. Obtained ratios allow calculating the coordinates of the emitters of a two-dimensional matrix to simulate targets both in azimuth and in elevation. It is shown that the matrix emitters lie in the same plane at the rectangle corners. The resulting array provides a target simulation at the same position for all receiving antennas. As an example, a matrix of four emitters was synthesized. The matrix has been tested using numerical modeling. The results of the numerical experiment confirmed the reliability of the obtained theoretical ratios.

articleTitle: Methodology for Assessing the Quality of Genomic Assembly Based on the Analysis of K-Mers Frequency in a Parallel Sequencing Sequencer
publicationTitle: 2021 XV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems Of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Counting the occurrence of different k-mers often arises in problems of genome assembly. Analysis of the frequency distribution of k-mers makes it possible to find assembly errors in already formed contigs. Currently, in connection with the development of instrumentation for genetic analysis, there is an urgent need to develop methods for assessing the quality of genomic assembly. Such techniques will make it possible to assess the reliability of genetic analysis in existing and newly developed devices. In this work, based on the analysis of various software tools, programs are selected that allow assessing the quality of genomic assembly in parallel sequencing sequencers. Using the selected programs, the data obtained on the domestic sequencer for parallel sequencing Nanofor SPS were processed. Based on the results of processing these data, the quality of the genomic assembly was assessed by the method of k-mers analysis and recommendations for improving the hardware and software of the Nanofor SPS device were given.

articleTitle: Propagation of Femtosecond Radiation in Air and the Formation of Subdiffraction Divergence Beams
publicationTitle: 2021 XV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems Of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The results of complex studies of propagation of a wide (5 cm diameter) femtosecond laser beam generated by a titanium-sapphire laser (wavelength 0.78 <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\mu\mathrm{m}$</tex>, peak pulse power 1 TW) are discussed. Both the location of the domain where filamentation occurs and its structure were changed by introducing controlled distortions of the wave phase at the expense of a multi-element deformable mirror. The advantages of using this mirror (compared to spherical lenses and mirrors) for laser radiation focusing are demonstrated. Focusing femtosecond laser radiation with a bimorph deformable mirror allows the filamentation region to be moved along the entire path and does not (significantly) decrease its length. The spatial position of the high-intensity light channels formed in the laser beam can be configured. The existence of a regime of radiation propagation without ionization is shown, in which ordered sets of high-intensity (10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">11</sup>–10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">12</sup> W/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>) weakly diverging (less than 0.01 mrad) light channels are formed. These channels are characterized by a millimeter diameter and large spatial extent (over 100 m).

articleTitle: Aircraft Heat Exchanger-Condenser: Modeling the Features of Heat Transfer Process
publicationTitle: 2021 XV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems Of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Thermal resistance of a radiator surface is formed in the course of a heat transfer at the expense of a heat-transfer coefficients ratio in hot and cold coolants. However, heat-transfer coefficients depend on a large number of factors. Factors which are of great importance for the heat exchanger condenser: change of heat-transfer coefficients on initial sites of heat exchange canals and existence of condensation and evaporation processes in coolants. These factors essentially affect on thermal parameters of a heat transfer process. In this paper the two dimensional numerical model of the compact heat exchanger with two-phase coolants in cold and hot paths is described. The model also considers change of heat-transfer coefficients on initial sites of heat exchange canals. The results of the numerical research of a heat transfer in the aircraft condenser are presented in this work. Comparison and the analysis of three combinations of thermal resistance options are executed: without initial sites and a heat-mass transfer, taking into account initial sites without a heat-mass transfer (dry air), taking into account initial sites and a heat-mass transfer in coolants.

articleTitle: Experimental Data Processing Language
publicationTitle: 2021 XV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems Of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The presented material considers a model of a technological experiment (phenomenon), in the description of which, the uncertainty factor should be taken into account. To overcome given difficulty, the theory of probability was used in the application of the Least Squares Method in the processing of experimental data on the attenuation of fiber-optic communication lines and the subsequent calculation of the approximating function. The paper is based on a summary of the Least Squares criterion and a purely analytical proof in the second section. The importance of the third section is a model of a real phenomenon that determines the comparison of stochastic damping optimization distributions. In the proposed example of the third section, the levels of the signal-to-noise ratio at a wavelength of <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\lambda=1550$</tex> nm are used when monitoring an optical fiber using the Brillouin reflectometry method. The optical equivalent of an electronic time domain reflectometer (OTDR) methods is actively used in the field of fiber optics, using the latest advances in measurement technology, optical communication and scientific research. At the present time, when many thousands of kilometers of optical lines have been launched, the task of their long-term reliability is acquiring special urgency. To solve this problem, Brillouin reflectometers (BOTDR) have been developed, which measure the optical properties of the fiber and allow predicting incidents during the operation of a fiber-optic communication line.

articleTitle: Program Module Development for Generation Structural Alternatives Serial-parallel Functional Networks
publicationTitle: 2021 XV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems Of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The paper considers the field of designing functional networks in human-machine systems based on the functional-structural theory. Current research is constructing an algorithm for generation structural and parametrical alternatives serial-parallel functional network. The description of software development that will help in automation of the design processes for hybrid expert system Intellect-3was made based on the proposed algorithms. The existed functioning will be updated and a new module will be created in purpose to extend an ability of this module realization. There will be used a new stack of technologies which include .NET 6, C# 10 and ML.NET. It will help in creation a storage, which will collect all functional networks for a future use. The storage will help in creation a knowledge base, which will be very useful in filtration and functional network search, and it will be possible to classify functional networks in the future updates of Intellect-3.

articleTitle: Methodology and Analysis of SWC Mapping with Scheduling and Safety Requirements in Automotive
publicationTitle: 2021 XV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems Of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: Software development models in the automotive industry have already been formalised and standardised. Consortiums like AUTOSAR have defined development methodologies, software architectures and interfaces. A common mapping scheme that covers the simplification of the development process is still a challenge because of the various standards and criteria that need to be considered before on-road deployment of individual applications. Also, as the software complexity is increasing day-by-day hardware resources and computation power still remains limited, thereby further increases the mapping complexity. The ever increasing demand of computational and communication resources by automotive applications such as image processing, deep learning etc. is only making this problem worse. SWC being the core functional elements can be focused upon for such a scheme and for which a methodology has been already presented in [1]. This paper proposes scheduling and bunching algorithms of the SWCs within the overall concept of the proposed mapping methodology.

articleTitle: The Behavioral Models of Suppressors and Devices Based on Them
publicationTitle: 2021 XV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems Of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The results of modeling suppressors and protection devices based on them are presented in the form of a separate library using the Cadence software environment (OrCAD). The presented behavioral models of suppressors are developed for the domestic element base and allow more accurately representing the current-voltage characteristics in comparison with standard SPISE models. The behavioral models include typical SPICE components of the OrCAD software environment, such as passive elements, semiconductors, and controlled current and voltage sources. The protective devices include suppressors and assemblies based on them, designed to protect one line or two channels. The simulation results for low (100 Hz) and high (40 kHz) frequencies are presented. The studied protective devices have a high degree of protection against electrostatic discharges at an extremely low level of their own capacity, which allows them to be included in circuits with operating frequencies up to 3 GHz and successfully protect digital interfaces (USB, MHL/MDDI, LVDS, etc.), as well as multimedia ports of displays and memory cards.

articleTitle: Assessment of the Applicability Gamma Ray Attenuation Method for Measurement of Three-PhasePermeability of Core Samples
publicationTitle: 2021 XV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems Of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: A gamma-ray attenuation method is an effective way for measurement of fraction content in oil/water mix in the petroleum industry. In particular, it is successfully applied for measurements of oil content of three-phase flux (oil/water/gas) in flowmeters of producing oil and gas wells. Another application of gamma densitometry is a direct measurement of dynamics of saturation of rock core samples in experimental studies of multiphase fluid filtration. Nonetheless, a realization of such measurement has a fundamental limitation associated with the large absorption of radiation in the core material and a weak dependence of attenuation on the composition of the fluid. The objectives of this work are to determine the optimal energies of gamma rays and to evaluate the time need for collecting sufficient statistics required to measure oil and water concentrations in the core. Based on the analysis of statistical errors, the optimal energy was found for one (“low energy”) of the two spectral lines used for the radiography of 40 keV. The energy of the second spectral line should be within the range of 80–300 keV. For reasonable parameters of gamma-ray source and geometry of the system, oil content measurement accuracy of 1% can be reached in 100 seconds.

articleTitle: The Novel Approach to Mechanically Switched Capacitors Sizing for a Longwall Shearer
publicationTitle: 2021 XV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems Of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The widespread use of renewable energy sources has led to a slight decrease in a demand for thermal coal and, as a result, in the profitability of underground coal mining. In this regard, increasing the energy efficiency of the electrical complex of a coal mine becomes especially important. One of the ways to improve energy efficiency is to install reactive power compensation devices. However, due to preliminary studies of the process of reactive power consumption, there are no recommendations on the choice of the number of control steps for high-voltage explosion-proof mine capacitor units. This article is devoted to the study of the optimal arranging of the EPMCU for power factor correction of the longwall shearer of a coal mine. The assessment of the nature of the electric load of the shearer was carried out on the basis of a large amount of current load measurements. Analytical and optimization methods were used to select the power of the EPMCU steps. It is shown that the use of step compensating devices makes it possible to increase the efficiency of for power factor correction.

articleTitle: Heterogeneous Radio Communication System Operation Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 XV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems Of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The article presents a diagram of a heterogeneous radio system with operation modes. The problem of organizing the data transfer support of moving objects is considered. The powers of the mobile object sets are determined. The main problem is that mobile objects use different kind of radio systems with many operating modes. The approach to solve the problem of strong connectivity loss of the information transfer graph is proposed. The authors propose to consider the transition of information along the route from “native” mode to “non-native”, as “a jump” into another mode. The measure of the jump length, the length of the communication graph edge, the multiplicative model for calculating the efficiency of information passing along the route are introduced. The function to determine the overall efficiency of the information transmission route is presented. The function of finding the route from the source node to the receiver node is proposed. Using the functions of calculating the route efficiency and constructing the optimal route, the algorithm for establishing the connection between “native” and “non-native” systems is shown. The algorithm of transmitting the information about “gateways“ to “native” radio system for “non-native” radio systems is proposed, which makes it possible to build the distributed heterogeneous communication system. The stages of the information transfer algorithm in the heterogeneous environment are determined. The heterogeneous environment information transfer overall efficiency function <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$F$</tex> is introduced. The use of the genetic algorithm for finding the extremum of <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$F$</tex> is proposed.

articleTitle: Random Error Reduction in Phase Shift Interferometry
publicationTitle: 2021 XV International Scientific-Technical Conference on Actual Problems Of Electronic Instrument Engineering (APEIE)
abstract: The object of research in this article is a new approach to reducing the error of phase demodulation in phase-shifting interferometry. It is based on averaging a combination of functionally related sequences of interference patterns intensities, with the help of which the phase is demodulated. It is possible to average both individual phase values at separate points of the interference pattern and their differences between different points. The method is based on finding the phase difference at three arbitrary points of the interference pattern. Fixing one or two points of the interference pattern with other points, scanning is carried out over its entire surface. Thus, the authors obtain a set of phase differences between different points. Averaging them allows to reduce the influence of noise on the measurement result. Thus, for each point of the interference pattern, a set of phase values or phase differences is obtained.
